And if we get a season 2, I’m very excited to hopefully have people understand me better. But I’m not even sure I understand myself. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa during season 1 of hulu’s new reality show, fans get a closer look into bobbi’s life after divorcing from tech executive cory althoff in 2024. The mother of two showcases her signature deadpan humor while trading the podcast studio for reality TV.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although she never watched the secret lives of mormon wives before becoming a member of the spinoff cast, bobbi had one goal when she signed up. Unlike her Utah counterparts, the California resident wanted to avoid any feuds on social media.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the thing that i saw take place on that show that i think was really important for me to not do was just make videos about each other online,” she said. So I think that’s something we all agreed to early on. “I just think that impacts their mental health a lot, and it was negative. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but what only the closest people to me have known over the past four years is my time at dc studios has been trying, to say the last. I dislike the at-times corporate nature of the job (thanks to Peter for taking the brunt of that. ) I'm always a very hard worker, but as a filmmaker I would at least get to short breaks to unwind, and I've stolen even that time from both myself and my loved ones over the past four years.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while gunn will stop serving as the head of dc on december 1st, he's still got some involvement in the shared universe. Diungkapkan bahwa look, there's lots of fantastic storylines. ' And I buy into that. There's always a lot of opportunity. As the pigeon sang to Fievel in An American Tail, 'never say never. I’ve had such a wonderful time playing Superman in the past. I would never say never now.

Diungkapkan bahwa this comment quickly lit up the internet, with some fans who spent years watching the dc movies in order hoping to see cavill back in the cape. #ResoreTheSnyderVerse and give Zack Snyder his two planned Justice League sequels. That includes folks who are still hoping to see Warner Bros. I have another perspective, though.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as much as i loved cavill's take on superman, i don't think that he should be brought back as the character for the dcu. He'll once again be taking center stage for Man of Tomorrow, which looks like an exciting crossover featuring various heroes from the newly formed shared universe.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while the studio might be cutting ties with james gunn, i don't think that should mean the end of corenswet's tenure as kal-el. especially when compared to the more gritty tone of the SnyderVerse. He looks pitch perfect in Superman's costume and trunks, and I loved the kind, punk rock version of the character. Give the Hollywood star a chance to cook!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the next upcoming dc movie hitting theaters is man of tomorrow on july 9, 2027. Hopefully we get some information about what's coming in the DCU sooner rather than later.

Diungkapkan bahwa we always joke about it, but it’s 100% true. So, they’ll go, ‘Will you take a picture of us together?’ I’ll go, ‘Sure, no problem. Ever. ’ I take a picture.

Berdasarkan laporan, this happens everywhere. On the streets. Well, everyone but one: Will Friedle. At professional events. I’d have trouble believing this, only I saw it happen while watching a live event once, and it’s one the actor also remembers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a few months ago, i was watching an early raw event on netflix and danielle fishel was in attendance. That’s not really weird. Sebagaimana diketahui, later that week, we went to the opening of the wwe [raw] on netflix. ’ And so, they cut to the thing and there’s Danielle and I like [waving] and underneath it says ‘Danielle Fishel. #461. 5 Takeaways From China’s Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival

📅 14 Nov 2026

5 Takeaways From China’s Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/takeaways-china-golden-rooster-hundred-flowers-film-festival-1236755329/

Beyond Tony Leung Ka Fai’s win and a big night for local hits, a week of seminars and workshops showed how China’s industry is thinking about AI, global audiences and young talent.

China celebrated its Golden Rooster Awards this past Tuesday night in a glittering ceremony hosted inside the palatial Xiamen Strait Grand Theater in Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.

The southern seaside city hosted generations of stars — from current hotshot Jackson Yee (Resurrection) to acclaimed auteur Zhang Yimou — for an event that is the highlight of the annual state-run Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hong kong’s tony leung ka fai stole the show, winning his first golden rooster best actor nod for his turn as the villain in the larry yang-directed thriller the shadow’s edge — some 25 years on from sending hearts a flutter across the globe in jean-jacques annaud’s steamy the lover. One Monk. Two Estranged Irish Brothers Facing Trauma. Related Stories Movies 'One Sweet Hour': One Aging Elvis Impersonator. Movies How 'Red Ink' Pulled Off a Single-Take, 1940s Vampire Newsroom Thriller.

“I hope this is just the beginning of new journey,” said the veteran of more than 140 movies.

Behind the scenes the business of making movies was very much front and center, as the Chinese industry gathered for seminars and workshops it hopes will chart its future course.

Here’s what The Hollywood Reporter learned from the week:.

Yimou Urges Filmmakers to Stay Focused on the Story.

Sebagaimana diketahui, zhang yimou brought a sense of gravitas to proceedings across the week. The 76-year-old was there among all the fanfare at the event’s Golden Rooster Awards, handing out the Best Feature Film award to director Shen Ao and his WW2 drama Dead to Rights while also mingling with all the stars and watching on — in awe, like everyone in the room — as a massive dragon drone cruised the air overhead.

Yimou had also helped launch the industry side of proceedings with a “Stories That Travel: Chinese and Asian Cinema in Dialogue with the World” seminar that gathered reps from international festivals and, soon enough, saw talk turn to Artificial Intelligence and its effect on cinema.

With Zhang’s adaptation of Liu Cixin sci-fi classic The Three-Body Problem in the works the director revealed he’d started to dabble in the tech, with a dedicated team set up on set to explore how AI could be adapted to the filmmaking process.

In his own inimitable way, the director then set the scene for the week ahead when he urged his fellow filmmakers to do the same — but to never lose site of the main ingredient: The story.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the new technology is moving too fast,” the director said. But for me filmmaking is about the story that’s in my heart, and the only thing I can do is to tell it the best way I can. “The moment you blink, you are behind it. So, embrace this era. ”.

Star-Studded Golden Roosters Celebrate a Big Year for the Locals.

The news coming into the week was that so far this year Chinese cinemas have been dominated by Chinese movies, with eight of the year’s box office top 10 being domestic productions.

The industry itself has been big on spreading a message of diversification of content, and to that end the two films that dominated “China’s Oscars” could not possibly be more different in either style nor in content.

Sebagaimana diketahui, shen’s dead to rights — with golden rooster best actress winner gao ye shining — collected more than $380 million and sets itself around the infamous nanjing massacre and the real-life story of the photo studio that documented the horror. It’s a gripping often brutal tale — and features two of China’s most bankable stars in Gao and Liu Haoran (Detective Chinatown).

Sebagaimana diketahui, lan hongchun’s dear you — winner of both special jury prize and best screenplay — collected around $300 million and sets itself around the story of one of the thousands of migrant chinese families separated through economic necessity in the 1950s and ’60s. It’s a languid tear-jerker, and it stars a cast of complete unknowns.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dear you was the surprise hit of the year in china and it reached an enthusiastic global audience. Lan was beside himself on stage. “It feels like I’m dreaming,” he said. “I want to thank my grandma in heaven, because she told me so many stories when I was little. ”.

Opening night under the stars at the Bailuzhou Park Water Square in Xiamen was a treat for the young families who packed the venue for the China debut of another film that speaks to the Chinese diaspora and — the filmmakers hope — will to the domestic audience too.

Diungkapkan bahwa the singapore-spain-italy production the violinist has already won best film at the 2026 annecy international animation film festival and best animated film at the 19th asia pacific screen awards. Set among the Chinese community, it follows the fortunes of two childhood friends separated by war, and it had the audience, including all those kids, transfixed.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “singapore’s animation industry is very small, and the country is small too. “We started by looking overseas for co-producers. As it happened, we had a lot of friends in the animation industry. So, with a production of this scale, one person can’t do it alone,” co-director Ervin Han explained. So, all together, we’re telling a story about a part of the history of us Singaporean Chinese. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, producer cristiano bortone also took to the stage before the premiere and picked up on what was one of the central themes of this year’s festival: sharing chinese stories with the world. Bortone The Violinist “delves deeply into Chinese and Asian culture, while also capturing a European style and sensibility. ”.

“This is the beauty of blending our cultures,” he added.

China’s next generation was out in force across the industry events, and they basically filled the room at the “Golden Rooster Film Academy II: Ark Lab AI” workshop.

Diungkapkan bahwa lan tian, the creative director behind joint-generation ai model seedance 2. 5, took the room and didn’t shy away from exploring its impact in what turned into a candid discussion about how the technology was already impacting the film industry.

Berdasarkan laporan, the ai industry has been embraced in china arguably like anywhere else, and already has an estimated worth of around $176 billion, while the short-drama and digital film market is expected to top $6 billion this year. The pitch from Lan was on the savings the new tech can provide.

“If you get an investment of one million, or less than one million you might be able to produce something that looks like it cost 10 million,” he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but lan’s push was also to use his technology as a tool that supports “reality. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “my girlfriend is an actor so i know there is concern,” he said. But I want this prop to be real, too. “The creative approach I’m talking about may only require a studio and some props that interact with the actors. For instance, if I need to drink water, I want the water to be real. ”.

Festival Spotlight Turns to Young Filmmakers.

While AI dominated proceedings, it was encouraging to see young filmmakers committed to the traditions of cinema out and about.

Diungkapkan bahwa yan siyu was among those featured during pitching sessions that placed emerging talent in front of international festival and studio reps. Her debut Outside The Room of My Own focusses on the journey three generation of women who take back to their ancestral village, and she echoed the words of Zhang that had opened the whole week.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i want to reach out to people to let them know there is this film in china. “This film is not just my work, because I have a lot of people supporting me. It’s a female director’s debut and I can say it’s a really good film,” she said. It’s a story that comes from my heart — and in telling it I am sharing my deepest feelings. I can’t let them down. ”.

DC Studios To-Do List: Here’s What Incoming Boss Jeremy Latcham Will Sort Through From The Gunn-Safran Era

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://deadline.com/2026/11/dc-studios-movie-tv-list-jeremy-latcham-1237217689/

Sebagaimana diketahui, the news earlier this week of james gunn and peter safran’s exit from dc shook the town like suicide squad‘s starro stomping down melrose avenue. Now it’s up to incoming former Marvel executive and Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves producer Jeremy Latcham to sort through the groundwork that was laid before by the duo.

You can check out the list of lingering and active DC projects below.

Note, Latcham starts the job December 1, and we understand that no mandates have been given to him by Skydance co-CEO David Ellison in regards to what’s prioritized among those projects in development.

Berdasarkan laporan, gunn and safran’s “gods and monsters” vision, which was first unveiled in january 2023, was realized at 40%, with movies superman and supergirl made along with tv series lanterns and creature commandos. If a project wasn’t ready, it wasn’t ready, which is why we saw some of the early pitches promised — i. Having seen the ills in the Marvel Cinematic Universe owing to its overindulgence in the Disney+ era with features being fast-tracked and storylines between series and movies mish-moshed, Gunn was adamant about not rushing projects through development — or worse, going into production on a movie that was missing a third act. e. , Paradise Lost and Booster Gold series, and the antihero team The Authority feature — ultimately stall. Watch on Deadline.

Berdasarkan laporan, james mangold was circling swamp thing at one point a few years ago, but the five-time oscar-nominated filmmaker is currently making his paramount+ series copland a priority. Not to mention he’s also working on a motocross heist screenplay that reteams him with his A Complete Unknown star Timothée Chalamet for the film studio.

Diungkapkan bahwa another thing gunn and safran wanted to correct in warners’ dc-verse were the dueling tv and film mythologies for superheroes. Above all, Gunn’s m. Case in point: the CW series of Flash ended in May 2023, three weeks before the Ezra Miller-fronted movie hit theaters and bombed with $271. o. 4 million worldwide off a $200M production cost before P&A (the star’s tabloid headlines at the time didn’t help the movie either). The Gunn and Safran DC universe would see their characters having direct lines through live-action film and TV. Quite often a superhero’s storyline on TV was different on the big screen, or worse, competed against each other. was to bring zhuzh to a franchise that had grown stale after Christopher Nolan’s Dark Knight series.

It will be interesting to see whether Latcham remains as strict as Gunn and Safran were on development.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the run-up to the paramount-warner bros merger, gunn and safran didn’t greenlight any live-action feature films beyond what was currently in production, so only the batman part ii, man of tomorrow and the dynamic duo. Gunn has teased he’s got a screenplay he’s penning in the DC-verse post-Man of Tomorrow, but that greenlight will be up to Team Latcham (he worked with Gunn during Guardians of the Galaxy).

Berdasarkan laporan, a bulk of what gunn and safran leave behind to dc’s new owners are animated tv series. Given the nature of animation production, many of these projects are already in the works even though many don’t have a streaming or network home, or even a renewal.

Berdasarkan laporan, the new warner bros under skydance co-ceos ellison and ynon kreiz remains strictly about keeping everything in the black. There’s no room for box office kryptonite ala this past summer’s blunder Supergirl (production cost $186M, global box office $126. In a recent earnings call, the two were vocal about the bleeding that was going on in the YTD Warner Bros feature slate. 4M), arguably the only big miss during the Gunn and Safran administration (versus the previous Walter Hamada-run era that yielded The Flash, Shazam: Fury of the Gods and Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom).

Above all, the new Paramount administration, which declined comment for this story, is conscious about not repeating history, meaning cancelling a near-completed project to the greater upset of the town (remember how David Zaslav swatted Batgirl in August 2022? That was all before Gunn and Safran arrived on the scene).

Below is the list of projects remaining at DC.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, man of tomorrow (dir. Gunn took to Threads to respond to rumors that Skydance is making edits to the film. James Gunn) – The Superman sequel starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult is in post-production and set for release on July 9, 2027. “No one from Skydance has even seen the movie – the only people that have are Peter Safran and a very small trusted group of friends and family. Buzz is that Lanterns segues into this Superman. So any stories around this narrative are false,” exclaimed the MCU and DCU filmmaker.

Diungkapkan bahwa the batman part ii (dir. Matt Reeves). After Reeves stepped away for personal reasons, Steven Soderbergh is finishing the sequel to 2022’s $772M-grossing Robert Pattinson movie in London for a February 18, 2018 theatrical release.

Diungkapkan bahwa dynamic duo (dir arthur mintz) – the origin story of the robins is a co-production with warner bros pictures animation, 6th and idaho and new orleans animation studio swaybox. The latter is known for their “momo animation,” which is a cross between CGI animation, stop-motion practical elements and live-action real-time performance. Pic will hit theaters on September 22, 2028.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bat-fam – season 1 premiered in november 2025, with the second half of the season still to air on the prime video series showrun by mike roth. Joining the family dinner table is Alicia Pennyworth, Alfred’s free-spirited grandniece; Claire, a recently reformed Super-Villain; Ra’s al Ghul, Damian’s adoring “Pap Pap” who also happens to be Batman’s longtime nemesis; and Man-Bat, who takes up residence in the belfry. Oh! And let’s not forget Selina, the beloved family cat. Batman, Alfred and young Damian Wayne — having taken on the mantle of “Little Batman” — welcome a few new residents to Wayne Manor. This close-knit family of misfits navigate the fun and frustrations of ordinary life while protecting the streets of Gotham City.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, batman caped crusader – the prime video series has clocked two seasons and is awaiting renewal. Executive producers/showrunners are James Tucker and Geoffrey Thorne. EPs are Bruce Timm, James Abrams and Matt Reeves.

Sebagaimana diketahui, batman: knightfall – the home entertainment animated feature from director jeff wamester and producer jim krieg. Part 1 was released in August, Part 2 is happening in December and Part 3 is coming in 2027. This movie event brings to life one of the most iconic sagas in Batman comics history.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the people vs gorilla grood – the hbo half hour comedy series, a spinoff of gunn’s superman, centers around skyler gisondo’s jimmy olsen and jimmy tatro’s titular ape. A super-intelligent ape is convicted of murdering his father, the King of Gorilla City. It is in post-production with no airdate yet. In an eight-part “true” crime docuseries, the Daily Planet’s Olsen reopens the case, investigating whether Gorilla Grodd was wrongly convicted in one of Metropolis’ most famous murder trials. Tony Yacenda and Dan Perrault are showrunners, writers and EPs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, creature commandos season 2 – the james gunn-created series is in production for a second season; gunn previously mentioned that an airdate was being eyed for the latter part of 2027. The series follows incarcerated monsters who are recruited for missions deemed too dangerous for humans. Characters joining in Season 2 are Khalis the Mummy, King Shark and Nosferata. Dean Lorey is the showrunner and EP.

Diungkapkan bahwa dc super powers – in production, with a network and streaming home tbd. Matt Beans is the showrunner. At the Alliance School for Heroes, new students Lightning, Flash, Plastic Man, Aquagirl, Green Lantern and Terra level up their powers under the supervision of Principal Martian Manhunter in the hopes of one day graduating and becoming the next generation of Earth’s defenders.

Diungkapkan bahwa get jiro – season 1 is currently airing on adult swim, while season 2 awaits a greenlight. EPs are showrunners Jordan Blum, Alessandro Tanaka and Brian Gatewood. Starring Brian Tee (Chicago Med), Get Jiro transports viewers to a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme and the world’s most powerful figures are chefs. In this society where food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro (Tee) sets out on a quest for vengeance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, joker: laugh riot – the anime joker series from director yasuhuro aoki (chao) is in its early days of production, has been greenlit to series and will be taken to market. When Batman is murdered, the Joker launches a ruthless crusade through Gotham’s underworld to find the killer who took away his greatest adversary. But as his violent quest for answers pushes him closer towards vigilante than villain, Joker is forced to confront the truth that without Batman, he doesn’t know who he is.

Berdasarkan laporan, mister miracle – tom king, who wrote the mister miracle comics with mitch gerads, is showrunning and eping this animated series that follows the “odyssey” of scott free aka mister miracle. No trap can contain him. But can he pull off the ultimate trick – and escape death itself? Something goes horribly wrong with the perfect life that Scott and his warrior wife Big Barda have built for themselves on Earth. He is Scott Free, the worldwide celebrity sensation known as Mister Miracle, and he is the greatest escape artist who ever lived. ” The series is in production but hasn’t been sold to a platform yet. Announced at Annecy 2025, the blurb for this series reads: No prison can hold him. It will be taken to market.

Diungkapkan bahwa my adventures with green lantern – jake wyatt, who is also the ep on my adventures with superman, is the showrunner for the 10-episode animated series, which follows jessica cruz (moana‘s auliʻi cravalho), who made her first appearance in the third season of my adventures with superman. To protect the Earth, Jess will have to overcome her fears, anxieties and your typical teenage drama to lead a new Lantern Corp against a terrifying foe. Things get even worse when more debris from the Lanterns’ ancient space war arrives – along with their alien foes. She’s a student at Hal Jordan Memorial High. Other Green Lantern characters in the show include Kyle Rayner and Kilowog. In production but not not sold to a platform a yet.

Diungkapkan bahwa my adventures with superman – this hasn’t been picked up for a fourth season but just finished season 3 on adult swim. Jake Wyatt is EP/showrunner. It’s the animated version of the Superman story with Superman falling in love with Lois Lane and her taking Jimmy Olsen under her wing.

Diungkapkan bahwa starfire – josie campbell, a writer on my adventures with superman, is leading the animated series project for dc studios and warner bros. The series followed the beloved Teen Titans superhero’s origins when she discovers an ancient spacecraft on her home planet and ventures out to the deepest places of the DC universe. Animation. In production but not sold to a platform yet.

Berdasarkan laporan, teen titans go! – the longest-running dc animated series, with season 9 currently airing on cartoon network and approaching its 500th episode. Luke Cormican is the showrunner.

Berdasarkan laporan, batman: brave and the bold – the feature project was first announced in 2023 when gunn and safran unveiled their “gods and monsters” slate with flash director andy muschietti attached to direct. Christina Hodson did a draft of the script. The comic revolves around Batman and his son, Damien Wayne, as Robin “who is a little son of a bitch,” exclaimed Gunn back in 2023. “Assassin, murderer who Batman takes on, who is Batman’s actual son that he doesn’t know exists for the first 8-10 years of his life… it’s a strange father-and-son story about the two of them and based on Grant Morrison’s run of The Batman. Muschietti has been busy on Season 2 of HBO’s IT: Welcome to Derry. There’s been no movement on this for quite some time however and it’s current slate is unclear. ” The dilemma with this project from the start is that it’s a complete reboot of Batman, and with the success of Reeves’ The Batman and its upcoming sequel, it’s unclear how two Batman live-action feature franchises could ever exist.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, savage hunters – aka the bane and deathstroke movie. Greg Mottola was attached to direct off a screenplay by Matthew Orton.

Teen Titans – At lst report, Supergirl scribe Ana Nogueira was taking a stab at it.

Wonder Woman – Ana Nogueira was also writing the first draft of this.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, absolute batman – from ep scott snyder, the series will reinvent the batman mythos for a new generation of fans, reimagining the dark knight as a working-class hero up against impossible odds (and the most terrifying foes ever), on a mission to prove that even in an era of wealth, power and corruption, one good person can change the world. When you take away the manor, the money, the advantages, what you’re left with is something absolute. No network yet.

Diungkapkan bahwa blue beetle – per deadline’s first report over two years ago, miguel puga (the casagrandes) was showrunner and director with cristian martinez (women of the movement, good trouble) set as writer of the animated series. Angel Manuel Soto and Gareth Dunnet-Alcocer, director and screenwriter of the 2023 film, respectively, were set to EP alongside John Rikard who served in the same capacity on the film.

Diungkapkan bahwa untitled krypto project – from ep c. Greenblatt. When he’s not hanging out with Superman or Supergirl, doggie Krypto tags along with a gang of misfit criminal wannabes who live down the block, and they soon discover he’s a ball of destructive, lovable energy worse than any of them. As he follows them into misadventures and poorly laid plans, Krypto’s pure nature slowly ends up redeeming them, whether they want it or not. H. No network yet.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lanterns season 2 – chris munday has assembled the writers room but no greenlight has been given to this hbo viewership hit. Lanterns’ Season 1 finale pulled in 10. 5M global viewers in its first three days, a series high.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, poison ivy – tw-time emmy-nominated the penguin showrunner lauren lefranc is in talks to produce. In regards to a Penguin Season 2, there is nothing in the works as Batman II is the most immediate priority.

#466. In Canada: Canada Music Fund to Receive $67M Boost; Women in Music Executive Award Winners Share Their Wisdom

📅 14 Nov 2026

In Canada: Canada Music Fund to Receive $67M Boost; Women in Music Executive Award Winners Share Their Wisdom

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.billboard.com/pro/canada-music-fund-67m-boost-canada-news/

Also this week: Sean Paul appears on the first episode of Billboard Canada News.

The Canada Music Fund is getting a new boost from the federal government.

Berdasarkan laporan, at last night’s adisq gala in montreal (nov. 8), the Minister of Canadian Identity and Culture, Marc Miller, announced that the federal government will invest $67 million to the Canada Music Fund, as part of the government’s promised $600 million investment into the cultural sector. The sum was first announced in June to provide “immediate relief” to the country’s audio and audiovisual sector and confirmed for 2026-27 in the latest federal budget, which was tabled last week. Over the weekend, Ottawa gave a long-awaited breakdown of how the funds will be allocated.

Diungkapkan bahwa the music sector will receive its share of the relief investment through the canada music fund, which was renewed through 2028 last year. The $67 million sum will be distributed to the five organizations that the fund supports, with FACTOR (Foundation Assisting Canadian Talent on Recordings) receiving $31. 7 million, the RadioStar fund receiving $3. 5 million, Musicaction (which funds and supports Francophone music and music companies) receiving $21 million, the Canadian Starmaker Fund receiving $5. 8 million and the Indigenous Music Office (IMO) receiving $5 million.

Diungkapkan bahwa last november, the imo released a new national report outlining ways in which the federal government could help indigenous artists and their music connect with bigger audiences, notably through increased discoverability on streaming platforms. Each of the funds will help support and foster emerging Canadian acts and help them compete on the world stage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “canada’s cultural sovereignty depends on our willingness to invest in our own voices,” says meg symsyk, president and ceo of factor. Our responsibility is to give that talent the opportunity to be heard, to build lasting careers and to reach audiences here at home and around the world. “We have extraordinary talent in this country. We thank Prime Minister Carney, Minister Champagne, Minister Miller and the Government of Canada for recognizing that investing in Canadian music is an investment in who we are. This investment in the Canada Music Fund backs Canadian artists and the independent businesses that help bring their music to life. ”.

FACTOR, along with the Indigenous Music Office, CIMA, ADISQ, Bell Media, Spotify and more all participated in CRTC public hearings last year to discuss how to support Canadian Content.

Now, FACTOR welcomes the government’s investment and highlights how it will support the Canadian music sector.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “behind every dollar invested in canadian music are artists taking the next step in their careers and canadian companies helping them get there,” says symsyk. “Sustained investment makes it possible to look beyond the next release or tour and build for the future. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, several other music organizations across canada are celebrating the news, with the canadian live music association (clma) saying it is “thrilled to see government recognize the value that music brings to canada, its businesses, and its communities. ” The Canadian Independent Music Association (CIMA) calls the additional funding an “important step toward strengthening the industrial ecosystem that supports the development of great Canadian artists. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “for years, cima has argued that the best way to ensure canadians hear canadian voices is to build a strong ecosystem of dynamic, globally competitive canadian music companies serving excellent canadian artists,” says andrew cash, president and ceo of cima. This investment is an important commitment, and a clear indication that the government has listened to the music sector. “These are the businesses that discover, develop and nurture artists, produce and promote Canadian music, help build audiences and create opportunities for Canadian artists to reach listeners both at home and around the world. ”.

The federal government’s new investment intends to bring stability to the cultural sector as “longer-term policy, regulatory and market conditions evolve,” such as the Online Streaming Act, whose implementation continues to be the subject of much debate between the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (CRTC), streaming giants and the United States, which has made the CanCon fund requirements for major foreign-owned streaming services a sticking point in trade negotiations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the live music sector is thriving more than ever in canada. In her role as chief commercial officer of Live Nation Canada, Melissa Bubb-Clarke is helping it soar towards new heights.

Berdasarkan laporan, on nov. 24, she will accept the Executive of the Year Award at Billboard Canada Women In Music, recognizing the important work she does behind the scenes, helping Canada’s live music giant scale its operations amid a rapidly growing industry, through collaborating and partnering with corporate brands.

The market leader in the country, Live Nation Canada has seen record success and revenue figures over the last few years, but in many ways Bubb-Clarke and the team she works with are just laying the foundation for an even bigger future.

Berdasarkan laporan, in its second season this summer, the 50,000-capacity rogers stadium welcomed a new record number of 20 concerts to toronto, drawing record-setting tours by headliners like bruno mars, bts, karol g and more. RBC Amphitheatre also kicked off its first season under its new name and partnership with RBC, which arrived alongside plans to become a year-round venue by 2030. There are more A-list artists coming to town than ever, but beyond welcoming shows, Bubb-Clarke is vying to create venues that offer an optimal experience for not just the artists playing them, but also the fans coming to see their favourite artist.

Preparing to accept the Billboard Canada Executive of the Year Award has given Bubb-Clarke the opportunity to reflect on the major strides she and her team have been making in the live music landscape over the past several years.

In an interview with Billboard Canada, Bubb-Clarke compares music to her work in sports at her previous company Maple Leafs Sports & Entertainment (MLSE), which owns the Toronto Maple Leafs and Toronto Raptors.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i can give you a million reasons why i think music is as much of a compelling offering, if not more, than sports. We do every demographic, every age group, all sorts of styles of music, I think we are super fan-friendly in that way. From a demographic standpoint, we’re serving everything to everybody with our 4,000+ shows that we do across Canada here with Live Nation. There are more concerts at Scotiabank Arena than there are [Maple] Leafs and Raptors games combined. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i think we have been able to understand what the fans have come to get, what they have been able to experience at a sports venue. They want to be able to have nice food and go to a specific place post-show or pre-show and have a great overall experience. They’re looking for a similar experience at a show. ”.

In her dual role as the president of MusiCounts and the chief operating officer of CARAS, the organization behind the Juno Awards and the Canadian Music Hall of Fame, Kristy Fletcher influences every stage of a Canadian musician’s career.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, through music education charity musicounts, she’s there at the beginning, providing access to instruments and musical education to give youth a chance to make music in the first place. At CARAS, she’s able to foster and develop the industry and recognize artists at the Juno Awards. That continues all the way until the later stages of their career, when they become Hall of Famers.

Diungkapkan bahwa on nov. 24, Fletcher will accept the Impact Award at Billboard Canada Women In Music, recognizing the important work she does affecting musicians both onstage and in classrooms, from Rush’s surprise comeback performance at the 2026 Juno Awards to young students who might be Canada’s next breakthrough rock stars.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this year, musicounts announced a $1. 4 million donation to support music education in Canadian schools, the biggest investment in the company’s history. Through the MusiCounts School Music Funding Programs, 96 schools across the country will receive support for their music programs amid increasing budget cuts and deficits in Ontario and throughout Canada.

Diungkapkan bahwa “music is such a foundational and fundamental part of development and growth for kids,” fletcher says. We have seen so many studies [showing how] music supports strong and healthy mental health, and develops positive self-esteem. “Think of all of the incredible benefits that music has on kids. It’s a way to sort out their emotions or express their feelings and thoughts, and it can improve mental health among youth. There are studies showing improved cognitive abilities with playing music.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “musicounts has to be there to help fill in some of those gaps, and the gaps do grow. We’ve been doing this work for almost 30 years and we’ve allocated over $22 million to schools and community programs across the country. You would think we would maybe be nearing the end of the work we have to do, and that’s just not the case. But that has allowed us to increase our programming. We’re just scratching the surface. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, read the full interview here. — Richard Trapunski.

“Canada has influenced my music in many ways,” says Sean Paul.

The Jamaican star is the subject of the first episode of Billboard Canada News, live now.

Berdasarkan laporan, in a revealing half-hour interview hosted by alicia west, paul talks about the important role that canada played in his come-up. He guested on the Baby Blue Sound Crew song “Money Jane” with Toronto hip-hop and R&B heroes Kardinal Offishall and Jully Black.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i was just telling somebody last night. They asked me who was the first person to put you on, give you a collab? And I said Kardi. Kardi Offishall,” he says. “First person to pay me, first person to put me on a track, I always say. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he also talks about shooting important breakthrough music videos “gimme the light” and “get busy” with canadian director director x (then little x) and dancer/choreographer tanisha scott, both longtime collaborators. His connection goes back even further, with his grandfather living in Scarborough, Ontario when he was young.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s a wide-ranging conversation about his whole career, from his biggest chart hits to his collaborations with major pop stars like rihanna and sia. He also talks about his support of Jamaica following Hurricane Melissa.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, watch the full interview on billboard canada news below. — Richard Trapunski.

#467. Michael Mann Seeks to Reclaim Rights to Original ‘Heat’ Screenplay

📅 14 Nov 2026

Michael Mann Seeks to Reclaim Rights to Original ‘Heat’ Screenplay

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://variety.com/2026/film/news/michael-mann-new-regency-heat-screenplay-lawsuit-1236947532/

Michael Mann, who is set to begin shooting the long-awaited “Heat 2” in January, is in a legal dispute with New Regency as he seeks to reclaim the copyright to his screenplay for the original film.

Berdasarkan laporan, new regency produced “heat,” released in 1995. The company filed a lawsuit on Friday arguing that it still owns the copyright to the original screenplay.

Diungkapkan bahwa earlier this year, mann’s lawyers sent termination notices invoking the right to reclaim the copyright. New Regency argues that the screenplay was a “work made for hire,” and is thus ineligible for copyright termination. Related Stories 'Off Campus' Sets Season 2 Release Date at Amazon Chris Pratt to Continue 'Terminal List' Story in 'Savage Son' Series for Amazon.

New Regency argues that Mann’s termination action clouds its ownership of the original “Heat,” and is seeking a declaration that the termination notices are void.

Mann’s lawyers intend to fight the lawsuit “vigorously,” his reps said in a statement.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “we will vigorously defend this action and are confident that the courts will vindicate michael mann’s statutory rights under the copyright act,” a spokesperson said. After 40 years Michael Mann is exercising the right of authors to reclaim their work and in this case Michael Mann’s original creation. “This filing has to do with original and personal writing Michael Mann did on multiple screenplays during the 1980s and which evolved into the iconic 1995 film ‘Heat’ that Mann wrote, produced and directed. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, mann developed the characters and the story that would become “heat” over two decades, beginning in the 1970s. According to the lawsuit, Warner Bros. acquired the rights to the “Heat” screenplay in 1994 in a deal with Mann’s loan-out company. The suit alleges that deal was explicitly a “work made for hire” agreement — not an assignment of rights — and that therefore it cannot be terminated.

Authors are allowed to terminate assignments of rights after 35 years under the Copyright Act.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to the suit, mann’s lawyers initially told new regency that mann had assigned his rights to his loan-out companies in 1988, and was thus seeking to terminate that agreement. New Regency sought a copy of that agreement, and was told it was an oral agreement, the suit states.

Diungkapkan bahwa “the oral assignment on which the first termination notice is based supposedly derives from an oral agreement that mann allegedly made with himself, in which mann, like a shakespearean actor playing multiple parts, simultaneously spoke on his own individual behalf, as well as on behalf of mmco. and ZZY,” the lawsuit states.

Two subsequent termination notices were submitted cited other agreements, both of which New Regency claims are also invalid.

Berdasarkan laporan, warner bros. was originally set to produce “Heat 2,” but backed out of the project last year. Amazon MGM Studios has since acquired the film. Both Mann and New Regency have done deals with Amazon that account for the copyright dispute, with Mann assigning any rights he may reclaim to Amazon, according to the complaint.

In other words, however the dispute comes out, “Heat 2” should be unaffected.

“For clarification, this is unrelated to production of Heat 2 which will begin shooting on January 19,” Mann’s rep said in a statement.

#468. New Regency Sues Michael Mann to Retain Rights to ‘Heat’

📅 14 Nov 2026

New Regency Sues Michael Mann to Retain Rights to ‘Heat’

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/new-regency-sues-michael-mann-retain-rights-heat-1236755347/

The production company is challenging the director's attempts to reclaim rights to the screenplay.

New Regency is suing Michael Mann to reassert its ownership over Heat ahead of the high-profile follow-up to the 1995 crime drama classic.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a lawsuit filed friday in california federal court, new regency argues that mann can’t exploit a copyright law provision that allows creators to claw back ownership of their works after a certain period. It seeks a court order clarifying that it retains the rights to the screenplay for Heat.

“The Screenplay is not subject to termination,” the complaint states.

Berdasarkan laporan, in a statement, a spokesperson for mann said the director is “confident that the courts will vindicate michael mann’s statutory rights under the copyright act. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “this filing has to do with original and personal writing michael mann did on multiple screenplays during the 1980s and which evolved into the iconic 1995 film heat that mann wrote, produced and directed,” the spokesperson added. “After 40 years, Michael Mann is exercising the right of authors to reclaim their work and, in this case, Michael Mann’s original creation. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the filing comes ahead of mann preparing to film heat 2, a sequel starring al pacino, robert de niro and the late val kilmer. The upcoming film is based on Mann’s 2022 novel of the same name, which serves as both a prequel and sequel to the original.

In Friday’s lawsuit, New Regency argues that Mann’s bids to terminate New Regency’s copyright for Heat are invalid because the director penned the screenplay as a work made for hire.

#490. Prime Video's 2-Season Action Thriller Just Surged 307% To Become the No. 1 Streaming Original

📅 14 Nov 2026

Prime Video's 2-Season Action Thriller Just Surged 307% To Become the No. 1 Streaming Original

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/terminal-list-prime-video-action-thriller-streaming/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when it comes to the host of action thrillers that you can find on prime video, none have made quite the waves that the terminal list has. 1 on Streaming" territory just last week. Based on the popular James Reece novels by former Navy SEAL-turned-author Jack Carr, the two-season drama has soared in the streaming charts, with Variety reporting that the show had even jumped into "No. With over 1. 3 billion minutes watched, the David DiGilio-created thriller continues to exceed expectations and is a reminder that the conspiracy-minded military thriller is as strong as ever.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for fans who have followed the terminal list since the first season dropped back in 2022, this doesn't come as a surprise. It wasn't long before Jack Carr famously noted that the show was made for fans, and the budding action franchise has been better for it. Rather than cater to whatever was safe or perhaps politically correct, the Chris Pratt drama largely stuck to its guns and pressed forward by expanding on what made the show successful in the first place, business as usual. Although initial reviews for the book-to-screen adaptation were not in the show's favor, the audience scores were exceptional. That decision paid off, with the prequel, The Terminal List: Dark Wolf, and the second season, based on the novel True Believer, leaning more into the type of material fans were hoping for after that inaugural batch of episodes — even if there were some changes made to the source material. Over time, the show and its spin-off have become more well-received even by reviewers, and The Terminal List only continues to expand.

Diungkapkan bahwa of course, the terminal list isn't just a successful show on streaming; it's one of prime video's best. It's a harrowing but complex story that could only be told with the freedom that Prime Video offered DiGilio, Carr, Pratt, and the rest of the creative minds involved. Over the last several years, the Amazon platform has become known as the definitive home of the action thriller. Pratt's James Reece is a protagonist haunted by his loss, one who seeks to redeem himself for the actions he took against those who wronged him — including his best friend. Sure, it can be a bit gruesome at times, but that's the world of espionage and off-the-books military operations for you. Reacher and Jack Ryan alone would probably be enough to solidify this idea, but The Terminal List and its Dark Wolf prequel have proven over and again that there are differing flavors of the action/military thriller flavor that deserve our undivided attention. The good news is, they're not done yet.

Berdasarkan laporan, for those worried that the true believer adaptation may be the end of the story, never fear. In Collider's interview with showrunner David DiGilio, the creator explained that they are always thinking of ways to expand The Terminal List world beyond just James Reece and Ben Edwards (Taylor Kitsch). While no official confirmation has been made as to what those projects may be (or their current status), we do know that the next James Reece story will be a book-to-screen take on the third Carr-penned novel, Savage Son, one that "Reecer" fans are anxious to see brought to life. How this will look exactly — as either a third season or a standalone series building off previous installments — is currently a mystery, but the news that the folks in charge have plans for a quicker turnaround is exciting. Hopefully, that means we'll also be getting more of the Dark Wolf prequel soon as well.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although chris pratt may be best known for his big-screen roles in the mcu and jurassic world franchises (or his time on the sitcom parks and recreation), the terminal list has more than proven that the star has the chops to tackle more serious and thematic material with ease. And yes, that was before he was a well-known movie star. Sometimes things just work out, and in the case of The Terminal List, there's no doubt that Amazon made the right call in not only adapting these beloved military thrillers but also in finding its leading man. "[He] was the person I thought of playing the role as I was writing the book," Carr once explained on his YouTube channel when speaking about the events leading up to the Prime Video series. The next season can't come soon enough.

The Terminal List is available for streaming on Prime Video.

#497. Who Is Sara Schell, The Newcomer Who Won Songwriter of the Year at the 2026 Latin Grammys?

Who Is Sara Schell, The Newcomer Who Won Songwriter of the Year at the 2026 Latin Grammys?

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.billboard.com/music/latin/meet-sara-schell-latin-grammy-songwriter-of-the-year-nominee-1236379607/

Meet the Venezuelan behind hits by KATSEYE, Becky G, J Balvin & other major stars.

EDITOR’S NOTE: This story has been updated with Schell’s victory.

Berdasarkan laporan, in 2020, sara schell was planning to move to london to study business after graduating high school in venezuela. On Thursday (Nov. 12), she won the Latin Grammy Award for songwriter of the year, and was also nominated for best pop song as a co-writer of Kany García’s “A La Niña Que Fui. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at 23, schell was not the only woman in the songwriter of the year category, but she was the only newcomer. She appeared alongside veterans like Edgar Barrera (who boasted 82 Latin Grammy nominations and 29 wins, including songwriter of the year for the past three years), Yoel Henríquez (who had garnered 23 nominations and three victories), Iván Gámez and Jenni Mosello (with a total of four nominations each).

Berdasarkan laporan, her credits listed by the latin recording academy included “a la niña que fui” by garcía, “ahí estabas tú” and “barco de papel” by fonseca, “bendito” by rawayana, “si te vas” by j balvin and jay wheeler (which reached no. 21 on the Hot 100), “Mercedes” by Becky G and Óscar Maydon (No. She’s also been behind chart hits like “Gabriela” by KATSEYE (No. 1 on Billboard‘s Latin Airplay chart), and “Vas a Quedarte” by Diego Torres and Manuel Carrasco. 1 on Regional Mexican Airplay) and “Ojos verdes” by Nicki Nicole (No. 1 on the Billboard Argentina Hot 100).

But how did this young woman from Barquisimeto go from wanting to study business to writing for major stars?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “in 2020, i graduated high school and then the pandemic hit, so we decided to move to mexico. When we arrived, I was supposed to go to London to study business because I had always said I wanted a career, but at that moment, all the universities were shut down, so we had to do what everyone else did: stay home and find something to do,” Schell tells Billboard Español in an interview from Spain during a break from a songwriting session. “I started posting covers and other things on Instagram, and that’s how I connected with several writers online, started doing Zoom sessions and writing together. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa schell’s musical training began at the age of four at the vicente emilio sojo conservatory, a prestigious institution founded in 1936 in barquisimeto, lara state, which works closely with venezuela’s national system of youth and children’s orchestras and choirs, a. a. There, she played the cello until she was 14 — a “super magical experience” that allowed her to travel to Peru and the U. representing her country. S. k. El Sistema. She also took piano and singing lessons.

Berdasarkan laporan, at 15, she wrote her first song, “sin ti o contigo,” which she uploaded to digital platforms, though it has since been taken down. “Then my heart was broken, and that’s when you start writing — because, you know, everyone needs therapy. “I remember I was falling asleep and a melody came to me, so I got up and went to the bathroom so I wouldn’t wake anyone up. What inspired me was that I was dating this guy, and we had broken up, so I started pouring it all out,” she says. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, but schell didn’t know people in her circle who could actually make a living from music, so she considered a more conventional university education necessary to “move forward. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, it was her father who advised her not to leave and to try her luck in music — “‘try what you’ve always loved,’ he told me, ‘give it two years'” — because his own parents hadn’t encouraged him to pursue his dreams. ’ So with me, he did the complete opposite. “My dad played music, did sports, he was great at everything, and my grandfather would say: ‘No, you’re going to study this. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, her first break came in 2024 with fuerza regida after a brief trip to miami, where she went with a demo of her songs and the idea of finding someone in the industry she’d heard about but “only knew his name was ben,” schell says. “At that moment, I didn’t know who Nir was. I told him: ‘Yeah, sure, let’s meet. ’ But I had no idea what I was walking into. There, she managed to have two or three songwriting sessions a day with different colleagues, and her name reached the ears of Nir Seroussi of Interscope, who contacted her to learn more about her work. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, upon meeting seroussi, schell says he immediately made her feel “like family,” and after listening to a couple of her songs, introduced her to ben tischker of wide eyed entertainment — the very same “ben” she had originally been looking for — who is now her manager. “It was incredible!” Schell says. “Then Nir helped me place a couple of songs, including my first one, ‘PXTXS,’ for Fuerza Regida.

Sebagaimana diketahui, originally written as a bolero, “pxtxs” — part of fuerza’s album dolido pero no arrepentido — is a heartbreak song about trying to overcome a breakup through excess and self-destruction. It turned out very beautiful. “It was a song that got a lot of attention at the time because it was a bolero that wasn’t vulgar but very raw,” says Schell. “I remember they replicated what I was doing with my voice on a guitar, and then they made it more regional. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa through interscope, the hit “gabriela” by katseye also came about. ’ I didn’t even know KATSEYE was such a big group. He said, ‘This one,’ sent it, and that was it,” she recalls. “It was quite strange because it happened very fast. “Normally songs take much longer to come out, but two months later the song was released and I started receiving tons of messages: ‘Congrats, congrats. They needed me to write a bridge in Spanish, and I remember sending Nir two options. And well, obviously it came out, and with everything that happened with the song, I’m very grateful to be part of it. ”.

Since then, she mentions Rawayana’s “Bendito” (“It was super fun to write, a blast”) and Kany García’s “A La Niña Que Fui” (“It was very beautiful how we connected”) among her favorite collaborations.

Berdasarkan laporan, in her august cover story interview with billboard español, garcía praised schell as a “super-talented” songwriter while recounting how this song, now competing for a latin grammy, came to be. (Its songwriting credits also include Rafa Arcaute, Nate Campany and Richi López).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i called her to write. But when you sit with creative people who are seeing the picture from outside, they see things that you don’t. And I told myself: ‘How beautiful it is that sometimes, as a songwriter, I think I have to do it all myself, that everything has to come from my head. I had melodies in my head, but nothing concrete… And she said to me — because it wasn’t me, it was her: ‘Hey, how about writing a song to your inner child?'” García recalled. “It gave me chills, because she didn’t know that the project was heading in that direction. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “just meeting her, and how i grasped what she wanted without her telling me,” says schell, “sometimes there’s this energy in the room that’s the most important, where the most magical songs come from, and i feel like we walked in and captured it right away. ”.

Although she has released some music as a singer in the past year — mostly collaborations with Sistek, Gonza Silva and LAGOS — Schell, currently signed to MPub and Wide Eyed Publishing, says her “calling” has always been “writing for others” and that she doesn’t plan to have a career as a performer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “from the moment we met sara, we recognized an exceptional talent in her,” daniela méndez varón, head of a&r at mpub, tells billboard. “Her artistic sensitivity, versatility and vision as a songwriter set her apart, but it’s her human qualities that make her even more special. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for how she found out about her latin grammy nominations, the songwriter recalls going to bed exhausted after a long day’s work and not even setting her alarm to catch the announcement. “But obviously, I was nervous,” she says. ’ I was like: ‘Oh my God. “I left my phone’s sound on, and I got a call from producer Héctor Mazzarri, who’s one of my best friends — also nominated this year, by the way — telling me: ‘Congratulations. ’ And I’m like: ‘What happened?’ ‘Songwriter of the Year. '”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, meanwhile, her dad couldn’t be prouder: “he’s so happy. So he’s like: ‘I knew it from the beginning. ’ It’s very sweet. I mean, of course he could believe it. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when asked who she’d like to write songs with, schell doesn’t hesitate. “Franco De Vita. You know, being from Venezuela, I grew up listening to him, and it was the music I listened to most with my grandparents,” she says with a smile.

#502. 5 Best New Movies And Shows To Stream This Weekend On Netflix, Prime Video, HBO Max, And More (Nov. 13-15)

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2313651/best-movies-tv-shows-streaming-netflix-prime-video-hbo-max-november-13-15-weekend/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, can you believe we're halfway through november? wild. 2026 is passing by alarmingly quickly, and we're about to hit full holiday mode as we approach Thanksgiving. but you don't need to get your turkey and stuffing recipes out of storage just yet. We've still got some time, and you should consider using that time to watch a whole bunch of stuff.

Diungkapkan bahwa yes, it's time to round up the buzziest, best, and biggest streaming releases for the weekend of friday, november 13 to sunday, november 15, which does include releases from earlier in the week as well. As always, the list is limited to releases new to major streamers entirely (case in point: though the hit Colleen Hoover movie adaptation "Reminders of Him" only just came to Netflix, it was already available on Peacock, so that's a nonstarter here), but between a killer dinosaur flick, a new thriller starring an Oscar winner, a drama with an innovative structure, a fresh literary adaptation, and the continuation of a massive fantasy series, you've got plenty of options.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you didn't get enough jessica chastain in this year's admittedly silly horror movie "other mommy," you're in luck — she has a new film coming to netflix this weekend. As Misty tries to locate Charlie, other family secrets come to light, and she tangles with a criminal underbelly in Nashville in the process. Written and directed by Shana Feste (the filmmaker behind "Country Strong," "Run Sweetheart Run," and "Boundaries," to name a few), "Heartland" stars the Oscar-winning Chastain as Misty Jones, a country singer who's retired from show business but has to come out of her self-imposed solitude to find her niece Charlie Heart (real country singer Carter Faith), who's gone missing. and the fact that Misty is notoriously prickly and was nicknamed the "queen of mean" in her days as a country star certainly doesn't help matters.

Diungkapkan bahwa "heartland" also stars john hawkes, garrett hedlund, jennifer nettles, and ross lynch in supporting roles, but chastain is the real draw here, and whether or not you saw or loved "other mommy," you should check this pick out. "Heartland" drops on Netflix on November 13, so stay in this Friday and have a movie night.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you, like me, love dark and twisted thrillers, you're probably familiar with the name karin slaughter. Indeed, ABC's massively successful procedural "Will Trent" is adapted from Slaughter's novel series about an Atlanta detective (though it tones down some of the more depraved stuff found in the books), and in 2022, Netflix released a series adaptation of Slaughter's novel "Pieces of Her" starring Toni Collette and Bella Heathcote in its lead roles. (Incredibly, I'm pretty sure that's her actual name. ) Even casual TV fans are aware of her, even if they think they're not. Now, Slaughter's book "The Good Daughter" is getting an adaptation from Peacock, and it stars two of the most talented women acting today: Rose Byrne and Meghann Fahy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the premise of "the good daughter" is enticing on its own: decades after a brutal and violent incident in the quinn family, sisters samantha and charlotte (byrne and fahy) still reside in their hometown of pikeville, georgia, with charlotte working in law enforcement. Byrne and Fahy are both excellent on the show, and they're joined by Brendan Gleeson, Harper Steele, and Paula Malcomson, just to name a few. Hence, when she starts looking into a particularly violent crime, Charlotte is struck by her own experiences, as is Samantha — and new family secrets come to light. So, whether or not you're already a fan of Slaughter's body of work, you'll definitely want to get acquainted with "The Good Daughter," which dropped all of its episodes on Peacock on Thursday, November 12.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, peter jackson's "lord of the rings" film trilogy was a cinematic triumph when it released over the course of three years in the early 2000s, and it stands the test of time (though, the same can't really be said of his interminably drawn-out three-part "hobbit" prequel). So, if you've already watched the extended versions of every single "Lord of the Rings" movie thousands of times, I've got great news: Amazon Prime Video has a "Lord of the Rings" TV show, and it's entering its third season.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the lord of the rings: the rings of power," which has been running since 2022, takes its lore from the appendices of j. Tolkien's massive fantasy tomes (but notably not Tolkien's "The Silmarillion" due to rights issues, so that has yet to be fully adapted). There are some "familiar" faces here from the Jackson movie trilogy, like Galadriel (Morfydd Clark) and Elrond (Robert Aramayo), but "The Rings of Power" admirably expands the world of Tolkien during the second age of Middle-earth. This is also, incidentally, when the Rings of Power (that's the title) were forged, which led to the rise of the Dark Lord Sauron (Charlie Vickers). R. R. As such, there's plenty to explore as this series forges ahead.

Berdasarkan laporan, the first four episodes of "the lord of the rings: the rings of power" season 3 dropped on amazon prime video on november 11. Two more will arrive on November 18, and the season will wrap up one week later on November 25.

Berdasarkan laporan, i truly cannot believe a movie as delightfully weird and ambitious as "the end of oak street" got made in the first place, but i sure am happy that it did. (There's also a family dog, Starbuck, and don't worry — nothing bad happens to him. That's as close to a spoiler as I'll get. David Robert Mitchell ("It Follows," "Under the Silver Lake") helmed this ode to dinosaur movies, summer blockbusters, and 1980s Steven Spielberg classics, which stars Ewan McGregor as Greg Platt, Anne Hathaway as his wife and aspiring writer Denise, Maisy Stella as the couple's eldest child Audrey, and Christian Convery as their son and youngest Brian. ) The Platts are an everyday family with everyday problems — Greg is secretly working as a pizza delivery driver after losing his job, while Denise is growing dissatisfied with their suburban life — but one night, a storm hits and traps them all in a bizarre prehistoric playground full of dinosaurs. This sounds almost magical, but here's the thing: those dinosaurs are starving.

Diungkapkan bahwa on one level, "the end of oak street" is the only movie in existence, as far as i'm aware, where you can watch anne hathaway wreak havoc on dinosaurs with a shotgun. What "The End of Oak Street" is above all else, though, is fun. On another level, it's a treatise on the importance on family, and on another level, it's an audacious science-fiction story with a little bit of time travel and a lot left unexplained. and it's streaming on HBO Max as of November 13.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the aughts, "24" innovated a new style of episodic television by using a real-time conceit as a spy tries to save the world. Decades later, "The Pitt" used that same structure to great effect for its real-time experience of working a busy 15-hour emergency room shift. Apple TV's new drama series "12 12 12," though, is even stranger. Created by creative partners Jim Keeble and Dudi Appleton, "12 12 12" stars Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan as Jack Strickland and Bobby Galvin, two men involved with a high-risk heist in Zürich.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, how does "12 12 12" tell its story? as former fbi agent strickland and master criminal galvin circle each other in europe, the heist in zürich is where they eventually meet. and Keeble and Appleton use three timelines within each episode. First, you get the 12 months of planning the heist, followed by the 12 hours required for said heist — and finally, the 12 days' worth of heist-related aftermath. "12 12 12" also stars Jack Kesy, Kali Reis, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson, and Patrick Fabian in supporting roles, and its first two episodes are streaming on Apple TV as of November 13.

Mariana di Girolamo at Vanity Fair's Screening Room at LACMA on November 13, 2026.

For rising star Mariana di Girolamo, a Chilean actress making her English language movie debut with Wild Horse Nine, she was excited and only slightly intimidated to be a part of the cast.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it was quite a challenge to perform for the first time in english," she said. I was laughing about these things and feeling empathy with these CIA agents that committed a lot of horrific, horrific things. "It was my first time approaching that period of time in this way with this very beautiful dark humor. I've never read something like that, and the arc of my character is so beautiful, unique, I really wanted to be part of this. "I prepared myself with a coach and we rehearsed with John, Sam and Parker [Posey] and Ailin [Salas] in a public theater in New York where I heard the script for the first time. That was amazing for me, for us. " di Girolamo, who is very familiar with the fraught period of Chilean history depicted in the film, said she appreciated how McDonagh put it all in context. ".

Maria di Girolamo, John Malkovich and Martin McDonagh, in conversation with Rebecca Ford at Vanity Fair's Screening Room at LACMA on Friday, November 13, 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the inaugural edition of vanity fair's screening room pairs this year’s most compelling films with a slate of programming that includes post-screening panels and conversations with actors and filmmakers. The invitation-only events are welcoming an audience from the worlds of film, fashion, culture, politics, media, and tech, much like the magazine itself. VF editor Daniel Kile introduced the first screening, welcoming the audience to the Steve Tisch Theater at LACMA, which is not yet open to the public.

Following the program in Los Angeles, Vanity Fair’s Screening Room will arrive in New York, where screenings and events will take place at Cherry Lane Theatre from December 4–6.
