#705. Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Actually the Perfect Way to Introduce Kids to Nintendo

📅 14 Nov 2026

Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Actually the Perfect Way to Introduce Kids to Nintendo

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/zelda-ocarina-time-first-nintendo-kids-game/

Diungkapkan bahwa walk into the legend of zelda: ocarina of time’s kokiri forest, and it feels like you’re walking into a picture book. Then you walk into the Great Deku Tree and spiders start falling from the ceiling. Kokiri children are rhythmically attending to their tasks. Fairies flit about. Everyone is friendly, everything is beautiful, and the world both feels safe and makes sense. Especially in the remake, everything is moss-green and dappled with light. My daughter screamed. I jumped, too, and I knew they were coming.

Sebagaimana diketahui, since zelda: ocarina of time returned nov. A few parents are playing with their kids, but skipping whole dungeons in an effort to save their children some nightmares. Some players say the new graphics make the spiders and the ReDeads worse. 5 with its splashy Switch 2 remake, parents on Reddit have argued over how scary (read: appropriate for kids) it is. Others played at age eight and turned out fine. All fair strategies, and they raise the question: Can a game with a screaming zombie in an underground mausoleum be a kid's first Nintendo game? Parents of kids as young as 4 and 5 are asking, despite the game’s official E10+ rating.

Berdasarkan laporan, i’ve played the three child-era dungeons with my 4-year-old. But so are the tools for fighting it. Fear is quite present in this game. Which makes Ocarina of Time — The Legend of Zelda’s fairy tale — the perfect way to introduce kids to Nintendo.

Diungkapkan bahwa the redead’s paralyzing scream, dead hand reaching up through the floor of the well, the long walk through the shadow temple: parents who grew up with the n64 ocarina of time tend to have the same laundry list of nightmares. Most of these live in the later dungeons, though, and there’s a fair chance that nearly three decades of remembering these seminal gaming experiences have amplified the dread.

Parents of kids playing for the first time in 2026 report smaller, easier-to-navigate fears: 4-year-olds who panicked at the first boss and lit up at the second, spiders that terrified them until they learned to hit back.

Diungkapkan bahwa good fairy tales have always been a little scary. K. Chesterton wrote that a baby has known the dragon "intimately ever since he had an imagination," and that what the fairy tale supplies is "a St. George to kill the dragon. G. " Here, we have a tiny Link — a peer to my child — facing something scary and fighting back, with appropriate tools to deal with the fun-sized dangers at hand. The child-era half of the game is there for a reason: It's not not scary, but kids are largely good with it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, eiji aonuma describes hyrule as a world with a bright side and a dark side. " The remake's tools could make something "very, very scary" if the team tried, he said, but the game is "supposed to be for all kinds of players. Link comes from the bright part, Aonuma told one interviewer, and Ganon from the part with "a lot of scary things. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa art director aya shida wanted a hyrule convincing enough to believe in without being literal about it. Her team reached for puppet shows and practical-effects films because both make fantasy characters feel real without reproducing reality exactly. The setting "feels somewhat dark," she said, and the colorful, quirky characters who live in it give the game its "mysterious, almost dreamlike charm. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa in a world built that way, the dark stays a fairy tale's dark: frightening enough to feel real, and charming enough to keep playing. So does Navi. (How did it get in there? My kid wants to know. You’re running away from the spiders, but running toward the opportunity to free a squawking chicken from a wooden box. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, after link pulls the master sword from the stone and ages seven years, the game does get darker. Some are holding the Well and the Shadow Temple back, and commenters in some Reddit threads suggest waiting until kids are 8 or 9 before starting at all. Others report a 4-year-old who lit up when Link grew up and a 15-year-old who cried at the ending. Parents of young children have come up with strategies to match. (I find this deeply relatable; same on both counts. ) Reading comes up constantly, with parents reading the dialogue aloud for the youngest kids and some crediting the game with teaching their kids to read.

Diungkapkan bahwa whether any individual child is ready for this game is, of course, an individual decision, one that every parent will make based on their knowledge of their unique kid. The Great Deku Tree hands Link a mission with stakes he can understand and provides tools he can wield. But, for me, experiencing the remake along with my child made the sense of wonder Child Link feels as he steps out into this world palpable — and it gave me a new appreciation for the honestly very kid-friendly framing of the first half. By the time he meets bigger perils, he’s ready.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that’s all i can hope for my kid when she, too, is ready. We’re still in the first half on our playthrough. She laughed at me when I did a belly-flop into Kokiri Forest’s lake the first time I tried the dedicated jump button. She immediately clocked that the Keaton Mask looks like her beloved Pikachu, which is going to make following this game up with Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Super Mario Bros. I’ve gone on to play the Forest Temple without her, and, yes, it’s scarier, but it’s also longer and has more backtracking than she’d have patience for. Wonder, and Pokémon: Let’s Go! so, so easy. That temple and the grown-up half of the game will be there when she’s ready for it. She cheers “fight, mommy, fight!” when a Skulltula descends, thinks Jabu-Jabu’s Belly is gross — correct — and has fallen for Young Princess Ruto. I can’t wait to watch her grow into it, even if I’ll miss the days when only the child world had her full attention.

#706. An Incredible Hulk Issue Saved Marvel's X-Men Comic From Cancelation

📅 14 Nov 2026

An Incredible Hulk Issue Saved Marvel's X-Men Comic From Cancelation

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2310491/the-incredible-hulk-issue-saved-marvel-x-men-cancelation/

Can you imagine the X-Men without Wolverine? Well, as strange as it seems now that he's the face of the franchise, Logan only joined the X-Men in 1975, over a decade after the team's comic debut.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in those early years, "x-men" struggled. In fact, most of the defining qualities and characters of "X-Men" came not during that original stretch but during writer Chris Claremont's enormous 16-year-run (1975-1991). Magneto was well over a decade from his reinvention as a traumatized Holocaust survivor. There weren't many strong villains, either. Stan Lee and Jack Kirby's hearts weren't in it, and the character chemistry between the original team wasn't there. Things would get worse for the X-Men before they got better.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "x-men" sales weren't too impressive in the 1960s. The book didn't just face cancellation, it was effectively canceled in 1970. After "X-Men" #66, the comic only reprinted previous "X-Men" stories for five years. Roy Thomas, the former Marvel editor in chief who wrote the last leg of the original "X-Men" run that ended at #66, said that Marvel's publisher Martin Goodman was attempting to get some value out of the book without the cost of producing new stories.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the x-men still showed up as guest stars in other series, like steve englehart's watergate scandal-inspired arc of "captain america," "secret empire," so they hadn't been completely forgotten. Then, in 1975, the Marvel powers that be decided to give the X-Men another shot. Writer Len Wein got the job of writing the relaunch, "Giant-Size X-Men" #1, and used a character he'd debuted in a 1974 "Incredible Hulk" issue as part of the team.

Diungkapkan bahwa in wein and artist herb trimpe's "incredible hulk" #180-181, the hulk stumbles across the canadian border. There, he fights a short, ornery mutant with adamantium claws: Weapon X, aka the Wolverine.

Berdasarkan laporan, the exact creation of wolverine remains a disputed piece of comics history. The general historical consensus is that Roy Thomas came up with the notion for a Canadian superhero and possibly the name "Wolverine," while Len Wein and artist John Romita Sr. (then Marvel's art director) designed Wolverine as we know him. In recent years, Thomas has tried (and succeeded, at least officially) to claim a co-creator credit on Wolverine, which has angered many in the professional comics community, along with Wein's widow, Christine Valada.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, regardless, wein is the one who wrote logan's debut appearance in those "incredible hulk" issues — sparking the enduring hulk and wolverine rivalry — and then added him to the x-men, where he went from team jerk to breakout character. (His first ongoing series lasted only six issues. Perhaps the Hulk left some of his incredible invincibility behind in "X-Men" during that appearance. It's worth noting that the Hulk himself survived a brush with cancellation. ) Incidentally, the Hulk had also guest-starred in "X-Men" #66, the last one before its pseudo-cancellation. Batman: The Animated Series' First Pilot Was An Episode Of DC's Super Friends

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2310490/batman-the-animated-series-pilot-dc-super-friends-episode/

We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it can't be overstated what an evolutionary leap "batman: the animated series" was compared to previous "batman" cartoons. Compared to the cheap animation seen in Filmation's "The New Adventures of Batman" or Hanna-Barbera's "Super Friends" franchise, the Fleischer Studios-inspired aesthetic of "Batman: The Animated Series" looks even better. "Batman: The Animated Series" also never underrated the intelligence of its young audience, both in its dialogue and its willingness to let scenes run on atmosphere, not words.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it wasn't an overnight flip. There had been attempts to launch a new "Batman" cartoon for several years. It was the massive success of Tim Burton's "Batman" movie in 1989 that helped that finally let "Batman: The Animated Series" release them. Before that, future "Babylon 5" creator J. Michael Straczynski pitched "Batman and the New Robin," co-starring Batman and Jason Todd.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the 1980s, alan burnett — future producer and story editor on "batman: the animated series" who was then working on "super friends" — wrote a pilot for a "batman" series. But, per behind-the-scenes book "I Am The Night" by Daniel Dockery, "Hanna-Barbera and ABC weren't ready to commit to a dark Batman series. Burnett, a "Batman" comic fan since childhood, wanted a cartoon that would honor their darker spirit. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, we can glimpse burnett's vision and not just through "batman: the animated series. Scarecrow plots to exploit Batman's fear to defeat him, forcing Batman to face his past and overcome his terror. Overcome with fear, he flees. " While chasing Scarecrow (Andre Stojka), Batman (Adam West) stumbles into Crime Alley, where his parents were murdered. " His pilot became an episode of "The Super Powers Team: Galactic Guardians" titled "The Fear. Darker than most "Super Friends" episodes, "The Fear" serves as a "Batman: The Animated Series" beta test.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the fear" was the first depiction of batman's origin outside the comics and it feels extra special that adam west got to act it out. The episode understands the weight of this; it initially plays Batman's fear of Crime Alley as a mystery. Bruce has to explain to Robin (Casey Kasem) and Wonder Woman (BJ Ward) how his parents were killed and his vow to avenge them.

Diungkapkan bahwa these flashbacks, telling us how bruce wayne became who he is, are another sign of the episode's origins as a "batman" series pilot. Compare how "Batman: The Animated Series" didn't shy away from Bruce's past while also assuming that the audience already knew it. Yet despite the ambition of "The Fear," it's still a "Super Friends" episode written for young children.

Berdasarkan laporan, a revealing comparison is "the fear" and "nothing to fear," the first scarecrow episode of "batman: the animated series. ) In both episodes, Batman is plagued by fears related to his parents; in "Nothing to Fear," he's scared that his father would be disappointed in him. " The episode was scripted by Henry Gilroy and produced under the show's first story editor, Sean Catherine Derek. " (Ironically, Alan Burnett wasn't involved with "Nothing to Fear. Batman (Kevin Conroy) ultimately shakes off that doubt with a now immortal line: "I am vengeance! I am the night! I am Batman!".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "nothing to fear" shows some growing pains. Series co-creator Bruce Timm wasn't wholly satisfied with the episode, and tellingly, Scarecrow (Henry Polic II) would be redesigned, twice, later in the series. Bruce's self-doubts in "Nothing to Fear" are also set when an old colleague of his father's admonishes him for despoiling the Wayne family name.

Diungkapkan bahwa the original "batman" series bible described bruce wayne's public persona as careless, self-centered playboy "who spends all of his time frivolously squandering the wayne fortune. " This is, of course, a purposefully cultivated persona to ensure no one suspects he could be a hero like Batman. But "Batman: The Animated Series" instead generally depicted Bruce as a friendly guy outside the mask. "Nothing To Fear" is one of the show's earliest episodes, so this might be a holdover from that earlier characterization.

Berdasarkan laporan, still, when "nothing to fear" begins with a sweeping establishing shot of gotham (drawn on black paper as was standard on "batman"), it instantly has more atmosphere than "the fear" did. It also makes Batman's Scarecrow-induced hallucinations more frightening. When Batman is surrounded by fire, his father's face literally forms from the flames. After Scarecrow is dosed with his own poison, he imagines Batman as a monster.

Sebagaimana diketahui, speaking of, the scarecrow isn't spreading panic for its own sake like in "the fear. Once a psychology professor named Jonathan Crane, he used his students as test subjects for his fear drugs. Now, he wants to burn down the university that fired him. " In "Nothing to Fear," he's driven by revenge. Brief flashbacks to Crane's childhood and academic career explain he's always delighted in scaring people. Later "Batman: The Animated Series" episodes would continue digging much deeper, and more sympathetically, into their villains' pathologies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, instead of the super friends flying off into the sunrise with a captured scarecrow, "nothing to fear" has a melancholic ending. Bruce stands at his parents' grave, leaves a flower, and as he walks away his shadow morphs into Batman's. The tragedy of his childhood will continue to follow Batman as long as he lives.

#712. 'Twin Peaks Meets Stephen King' Series, Now A Major Netflix Hit, Only Has One Season Left

📅 14 Nov 2026

'Twin Peaks Meets Stephen King' Series, Now A Major Netflix Hit, Only Has One Season Left

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/from-netflix-hit-last-season/

Berdasarkan laporan, the horror mystery series from has been the main streaming attraction of mgm+ since its premiere in 2022. Starring Lost alum Harold Perrineau, From has drawn countless comparisons to the hit ABC mystery series. As From approaches its fifth and final season, though, the show is poised to stick the landing in a way that Lost's controversial series finale failed to do.

Set in a surreal, inescapable town, From is evocative of the town of Twin Peaks, complete with a diner and a sprawling nature backdrop and just enough eeriness to make those elements both ominous and cozy.

Berdasarkan laporan, the mysterious liminal space is populated with unassuming people from across the country who all encountered a fallen tree in the road that rerouted them to the desolate town that doesn't adhere to the rules of time and geography. Also, in classic horror fashion, the forest and tunnels underneath the town are full of flesh-eating monsters who emerge when the sun goes down.

As the townspeople have fought for their survival and searched for their escape, the mysteries of the Township have only deepened, and every season of From has revealed another layer of what has proven to be an ancient, cyclical battle between good and evil.

Though much of the ultimate meaning of the town and the survivors' purpose for being there remains unclear, From has rewritten the Township's rules ahead of its fifth and final season, placing the townspeople on a path of discovery that may finally provide the answers they, and viewers, have been searching for.

Sebagaimana diketahui, seasons 1-3 of from dropped on netflix on october 19th and swiftly became a top 10 performer for the platform. In fact, it has now been Netflix's number one show for two weeks in a row. Beyond even this achievement, From has garnered over two billion viewing minutes over a period where no other streaming series even surpassed one billion (The Hollywood Reporter).

Sebagaimana diketahui, from is the first acquired series to reach multi-billion viewing minutes since suits in 2023. Manifest was the first to accomplish this feat, and the series, which Netflix acquired from NBC, actually did it twice.

Diungkapkan bahwa having skyrocketed to this level of popularity after being on the platform for less than a month, it seems clear that from's comparably muted buzz in its first four seasons was a reflection of its streaming home rather than its quality. While MGM+ has begun attracting increasingly noteworthy talent, From was effectively the streamer's flagship series when it premiered in 2022.

Sebagaimana diketahui, from's netflix accomplishments have brought unprecedented attention to the series, but its story has actually always been uniquely suited to a spinoff. Recent seasons have revealed more of the Township's lore, including the idea that it goes through "cycles" that have historically concluded with the residents massacring each other, emptying the town for new arrivals to begin the cycle anew.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the show has even begun revealing details of previous cycles, as well as the idea that some townspeople from previous cycles are actually the past lives of current residents. The cyclical nature of the Township and the emotional connection that past cycles have to the main storyline make From a great contender for a prequel series.

After plenty of setup, From's season 3 finale reveals the full nature of Tabitha's connection to Miranda & Jade's connection to Christopher.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in fact, a similar format has already proven to be massively successful with hbo's it: welcome to derry, a stephen king prequel which has begun moving backwards in time through pennywise's similarly cyclical reigns of terror. Like From's Netflix arrival, Welcome to Derry drew notable viewership for HBO Max, signaling that audiences are open to expanding already-popular horror universes.

It remains to be seen if the world of From will grow beyond the main series, but either way, its Netflix success promises newfound attention on From's fifth and final season.

#715. This Beloved Sci-Fi Novel Is Finally Getting Adapted After 12 Years, but It’s All Wrong

📅 14 Nov 2026

This Beloved Sci-Fi Novel Is Finally Getting Adapted After 12 Years, but It’s All Wrong

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/sci-fi-novel-red-rising-adapted-wrong-movie-animated-series/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after 12 years and at least two scrapped attempts, red rising by pierce brown is finally getting adapted for the screen. With that much new momentum behind it, things are looking pretty good for this project, yet many fans still feel it taking the wrong approach. The news broke days after Paramount's parent company finalized its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, creating the conglomerate now known simply as Skydance. Last month, Paramount Pictures announced that it had purchased the film rights to the acclaimed science fiction series, and it had even assigned writer Justin Rhodes and director Francis Lawrence to the project. Like other doorstopper novels, this story might be better suited to a series than movies, and it might actually look better if it was animated rather than live-action.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these arguments have been made for several recent adaptations, and they've become increasingly popular among fans online. He told fans that he is simply trying to give the story its best chance at succeeding on the big screen, intimating that there are some very complex legal issues at play behind the scenes. In this case, Brown actually spoke up about the idea of animation directly on social media. Brown even suggested that an animated adaptation could come later if there's demand for it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a discussion with fans on instagram, brown assured fans that he did not compromise his own wishes in this latest deal to adapt red rising. He explained: "If the film works, everything is on the table. If animation failed, it's dead. It sounds like the author himself has wanted a live-action movie from the start. If the film fails, animation is still on the table. Goddamn you don't comprehend the legal/rights complexity it'd take to make it a film. If animation worked. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, it sounds like brown's pursuit of a live-action adaptation was at least partially motivated by the logic of sales. Red Rising is set in a distant future where humanity has colonized the entire solar system. It takes place on various planets, moons, and spacecraft, all with elaborate terraforming and engineering in place. It's nice to see him assuring fans that he is not opposed to the idea of animation for this story. On top of that, the characters are often flying, battling with advanced weaponry, or pulling off even more outrageous stunts that are hard to picture in live-action.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a "live-action" adaptation of red rising will really be a mass of special effects and cgi, which is why animation is such a popular option for fans. If the most important elements of the story are going to be animated by artists anyway, why not simplify the whole thing with a more stylized look? However, Brown's comments seem to suggest that it would be extremely difficult to sell a live-action adaptation after an animated adaptation, especially if the animated adaptation was unprofitable. That means the franchise's current course is its best chance of succeeding on multiple fronts, and it leaves other doors open as well.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, just a decade and a half ago, the idea of a fantasy novel adaptation performing better as a ten-episode series than a movie would have sounded strange in hollywood, then game of thrones came along. Today, many other long, epic fantasy and sci-fi novels are succeeding as series, and the medium seems to suit their stories better than movies would have. It may be that in a few years, we'll look back and talk about animated adaptations in the same way.

Diungkapkan bahwa animation is a natural choice for many of the best sci-fi and fantasy books, especially if the adaptations are going to rely heavily on cgi. If Hollywood can shift its attitude towards animation the way it did with TV adaptations, we could enter a whole new golden age of sci-fi and fantasy on the screen. Sadly, animation is still seen as a medium for children, or for cheap, niche projects. These stories could look beautiful in the hands of talented artists and animators, while voice actors could bring the characters to life. This practice could reign in some of the unbelievable budgets monopolizing the industry and put creative control back in the hands of a small, nimble team again.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that won't be the style for this upcoming adaptation of red rising, but it's good to know that the option is still there. So far there's no word on when the movie will start production or when it might hit theaters. In the meantime, there are six novels in the Red Rising saga available now in print, digital, and audiobook formats. Brown has been hard at work on the seventh and final novel, and could announce its publication date any day now.

#718. Keanu Reeves And Denzel Washington's Forgotten '90s Shakespeare Movie Is Worth Revisiting

📅 14 Nov 2026

Keanu Reeves And Denzel Washington's Forgotten '90s Shakespeare Movie Is Worth Revisiting

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2307161/keanu-reeves-denzel-washington-90s-shakespeare-movie-much-ado-about-nothing/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kenneth branagh's 1993 film adaptation of william shakespeare's "much ado about nothing" is, without hyperbole, one of the best films of its decade. And what a cast! Denzel Washington plays Don Pedro, a soldier returning home from the war, bringing with him the handsome young Claudio, played by Robert Sean Leonard, and Don Pedro's grumpy, villainous half-brother Don John, played by Keanu Reeves.

Diungkapkan bahwa additionally, branagh plays the sharp-witted benedick, and stands romantically opposite emma thompson, playing the even sharper-witted beatrice. Michael Keaton turns in one of his funniest performances as Dogberry, a slovenly cop. The actors were married at the time, and their scenes together play like gangbusters. Claudio falls in love with the pretty young Hero, played by Kate Beckinsale. Also keep an eye out for Imelda Staunton, Richard Briers, and the amazing Brian Blessed.

Berdasarkan laporan, branagh understood that shakespeare's text was so aggressively light and frothy that he needed to make a film that matched its tone and spirit. As such, "Much Ado" is bright, brisk, pastoral, and gorgeous. Despite a plot involving staged infidelity, faked deaths, and bitter reactions, the movie is overall an injection of liquid sunshine. And, naturally, as a comedy, everything works out in the end. The bulk of the film is laughter, romantic shenanigans, playfully flirtatious barbs, and relaxing summer night parties in the Sicilian countryside. I want to live in this movie.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there have been other recent, passable film renditions of "much ado" in recent years, including joss whedon's 2013 version, which bore the filmmaker's unique voice, and the 2023 romantic blockbuster "anyone but you" with sydney sweeney and glen powell, but neither can match the glories of branagh's version. It remains the high-water mark for filmed versions of this play.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "much ado about nothing" takes place in messina, and opens with a glorious homecoming from don pedro and his men. It also marks the reunion of bitter exes Beatrice and Benedick, who seemingly hate each other, but who verbally spar so well, it's quite clear they're romantically perfect for each other. This is a joyous occasion, and everyone in Messina is happy to begin a period of merry-making. Each of their friends schemes to force Beatrice and Benedick back into each other's arms, largely by being "overheard" in choice situations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, upon homecoming, claudio instantly falls for the pretty young hero, but he hasn't the wherewithal to charm her. A marriage is immediately arranged because this is Shakespeare, and comedies have to end with marriages. Luckily, at a masked ball, Don Pedro stands in for Claudio, successfully charming Hero in his stead. Meanwhile, side characters are hooking up left and right. "Much Ado" is a marvelously horny movie, and every actor looks the best they have ever looked.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course don john is lurking in the shadows to foul everything up. Claudio, being a bit of a golden retriever, believes him and becomes bitter, rejecting Hero at the least opportune moment. He sees all the happiness at play and wishes to squelch it for reasons of generic villainy. He arranges for Claudio to witness a couple undressing in a window, convincing Claudio that he is witnessing Hero cheating on him already. And while there are some hard feelings of anguish, Branagh has already communicated through his film's bright white coloration, brisk music (by Patrick Doyle), and warm photography (by Roger Lanser), that everything is going to be fine.

Diungkapkan bahwa the only real issue one might take with branagh's "much ado about nothing" is — and i hate to say it — keanu reeves' performance. Reeves is a capable actor in the right kind of taciturn roles, and he is one of the best human beings we have on planet Earth, but he clearly struggles with Shakespeare's language. After "Much Ado" was released, a notable parody of Reeves' performance was featured on the TV series "The Critic," wherein Reeves was mockingly placed in a film version of "The Merchant of Venice," intoning, "Hath not a dude eyes?".

Diungkapkan bahwa but reeves' performance aside, "much ado" is pretty damn perfect. The film currently has a 90% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, based on 48 reviews. Roger Ebert gave the film three stars out of four, writing:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "sunshine and laughter, and merrymakers on a hillside sprinkled with flowers. In the opening scene of 'Much Ado About Nothing,' Kenneth Branagh insists on the tone the movie will take: These are healthy, joyful young people whose high spirits will survive anything, even the dark double-crosses of Shakespeare's plot. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for a while there, kenneth branagh was on a hot streak. His 1989 debut feature "Henry V," also based on Shakespeare, was a critical darling, and his 1991 past-lives noir "Dead Again" is way better than it has any right to be. The '90s were very good for Branagh overall, as he also made "Peter's Friends" (1992), "Mary Shelley's Frankenstein" in 1994 (which is better than you remember and accurate to Shelley's novel), "In the Bleak Midwinter" (1995), and one of the very best movie versions of "Hamlet" in 1996. "Much Ado" was just a bright, soft, white feather in his feather-festooned cap.

Sebagaimana diketahui, game crashes do happen sometimes. The best way to avoid losing the token and ending up in the same position as Michoh44 is to intentionally die in-game after obtaining it. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, news that james gunn and peter safran would be "stepping down" as dc studios co-heads shocked the industry. One of these rumors suggests that the upcoming "Superman" sequel, "Man of Tomorrow," will be significantly reworked ahead of its 2027 release. At this stage, there's been no official word on what might become of Gunn's DC Universe, but there has been all sorts of conjecture and rumors making the rounds. Now, Gunn has taken to social media to quash the rumor — though at this point it's hard to know who to believe.

Sebagaimana diketahui, following the warner bros. According to Gunn himself, however, it's all nonsense. According to the outlet, planned cameos are being cut and reshoots being planned. If Ellison is, indeed, planning to raze Gunn's cinematic universe, that would make sense. /Paramount merger, DC Studios now belongs to Skydance, and it seems the new ownership has big changes in store. Meanwhile, Nexus Point News published an article in which it cited sources claiming "Man of Tomorrow" is being trimmed down ahead of its July 2027 release. Reports have claimed that Skydance CEO David Ellison will dismantle Gunn's DC Universe following his departure. The director wrote a post on Threads stating:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "there are a lot of untrue rumors going around, but one of them is that skydance has seen 'man of tomorrow' and that all sorts of sweeping changes are being made. So any stories around this narrative are false. No one from Skydance has even seen the movie — the only people that have are Peter Safran and a very small trusted group of friends and family. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on one hand, it's reassuring to hear that james gunn will be able to finish his movie without skydance making changes. On the other, he didn't actually state unequivocally that the new owners wouldn't be altering "Man of Tomorrow," only that nobody from Skydance has seen the movie yet. But given what we're hearing about how David Ellison plans to reboot the DC Universe, and the fact he's appointed a new DC Studios head in Jeremy Latcham, it would make sense for "Man of Tomorrow" to be reworked.

" Nexus Point News' report claims that this is one of the cameos on the chopping block following Skydance's Warner takeover. If true, it would frankly make a lot of sense. Ellison clearly has plans for DC moving forward, and he won't want audiences confused by cameos that suggest the return of erstwhile heroes to a universe he plans to dismantle.

Diungkapkan bahwa page six has reported that gunn is only staying to finish "man of tomorrow" because directors guild of america rules mean he "could not be removed" from the project. According to the director himself, this is all untrue. If accurate, this suggests Ellison would have given Gunn the boot from his own movie if he could — adding more credence to the idea that Skydance wants to make changes to "Man of Tomorrow" and the DC Universe as a whole. But everything we've seen and heard suggests otherwise.

Diungkapkan bahwa a puck report has claimed that james gunn and peter safran's dc studios exit was driven in part by cost-cutting. Given all the financial promises David Ellison had to make in order to close the Warner/Paramount merger, and the fact Gunn and Safran were making a tidy little profit for themselves via a deal that gave them significant autonomy as DC Studios co-heads, that makes sense. As such, if Skydance is committed to putting out "Man of Tomorrow," it will want to do all it can make sure it's profitable while also trying not to misguide audiences with cameos and setups for a DC Universe future that simply isn't going to arrive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's unclear whether the same rules that supposedly prevented skydance from removing gunn from "man of tomorrow" will also prevent them from meddling too much in the final product. With Jeremy Latcham now set to oversee DC Studios, clearly the Skydance CEO has a different vision in mind for the brand moving forward. But it seems almost certain that Ellison will want to have some say in the movie. The fact that nobody from Skydance has seen "Man of Tomorrow," therefore, doesn't necessarily mean they don't have major changes planned.

Diungkapkan bahwa bearing in mind gunn and safran were previously told they would be staying on at skydance before ellison suddenly dropped the axe, it's hard to say who knows what over at dc studios. For now, Gunn clearly believes he'll be able to put out the "Superman" sequel he wants to make, but who's to say what might happen over the coming months. "Man of Tomorrow" is set for a July 9, 2027 release, and a lot can happen between now and then.

#724. ‘Club Kid’ Cinematographer Adam Newport-Berra on Capturing Intimate and Authentic New York Moments

📅 14 Nov 2026

‘Club Kid’ Cinematographer Adam Newport-Berra on Capturing Intimate and Authentic New York Moments

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://variety.com/2026/artisans/news/club-kid-cinematography-new-york-adam-newport-berra-1236938607/

Berdasarkan laporan, cinematographer adam newport-berra enjoys working with directors who also act in their films. This year alone, his work includes “The Invite” with director and actor Olivia Wilde, as well as teaming up with Jordan Firstman on A24’s “Club Kid,” in which Firstman directs and stars.

Diungkapkan bahwa newport-berra (variety’s 10 artisans to watch 2026) says, “i tend to enjoy working with actor-directors because we get this dynamic experience on set where they get to direct the film both from outside and from within during the scene, which i think is a special opportunity for a director to be able to be inside the scene, guiding it as it’s happening. ” Related Stories 'Hold Onto Me' Director Myrsini Aristidou Kicks Off Historic Oscar Campaign for Sundance Audience Award Winner: 'I Really Feel Like We're Underdogs'.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while “the invite” challenged him to work with wilde to be creative within a single space, “club kid” — which opens this weekend — is set in new york city. It follows a queer party promoter who has long outgrown his time on the scene. The film stars Firstman, Cara Delevingne, Diego Calva, Kirby Howell-Baptiste and Reggie Absolom. However, his life is upended when he suddenly meets the 10-year-old son (Absolom) he never knew he had, forcing him to grapple with the kind of life he wants to lead. Over time, Peter slowly begins to adjust to life with Arlo, and in one memorable scene, the pair sit at a piano as Newport-Berra’s camera slowly zooms out to capture a perfect evening and moment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, newport-berra shares, “originally, we were going to shoot a whole montage of them spending a day together that would culminate in this moment. ” However, time, budget and production priorities led to the montage being scrapped and the focus shifted to moving the piano up a flight of stairs. Newport-Berra recalls that after shooting in the apartment for a few weeks, the crew started feeling claustrophobic. “We were like, ‘What if we were looking at the apartment from this window or from that roof?’” The production team scouted until they found a building willing to let them shoot on the roof.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he continues, “we had this amazing zoom-out shot timed perfectly with a dolly shot inside. It starts with a dolly pulling out, which we lit and set up probably an hour or two before we were ready to shoot so we could get the perfect light. The camera outside doesn’t see the camera inside because it’s just off the window, hidden behind it. As the dolly camera pulls out, the other camera zooms out, keeping itself out of the shot so we could time everything perfectly to the exact moment of sunset. We let them rehearse and play around. There were two cameras rolling at the same time. It became this really magical moment. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, overall, newport-berra appreciated working with firstman, noting that they had shotlisted the entire film beforehand. Sometimes it was very clear to us that we wanted a very intimate, simple handheld camera, where I could just be between them — the three of us in the room. “But we were keen to take the temperature on set and figure out what the moment needed. The nuance of everything very much came from being in the moment together in the room. Other times, the camera needed to be locked off and observing the pair from a distance. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for capturing new york, newport-berra felt confident he could help portray an authentic version of the city. He started his career there, working on indie films, student projects and music videos. I lived there for over a decade and really fell in love with it. “I know the city very well. ” He adds that he and Firstman wanted to make “Club Kid” feel like an iconic, nostalgic New York movie, but with a fresh perspective. Their familiarity with the city helped immensely, as did Newport-Berra’s connections with local crew members that dated back to his student days.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “it was a very small movie,” he recalls. I’m proud we got to make that movie there. ” He concludes, “It was very much a New York indie movie and I love that. “We were all carrying camera cases upstairs, cramming into the back of a van to get from one location to another, loading film on the sidewalk and politely asking random bystanders to move out of the way so we could steal a shot. ”.

#725. 15 Best Hard Sci-Fi Movies Of All Time, Ranked

📅 14 Nov 2026

15 Best Hard Sci-Fi Movies Of All Time, Ranked

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2303935/best-hard-sci-fi-movies-ranked/

We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while science fiction includes everything from space opera to cyberpunk, one sub-genre that we have a special place for is hard sci-fi. These movies place a stronger emphasis on scientific accuracy and a more grounded premise than their more fantastical counterparts. Many of the best sci-fi movies ever are set within the realm of hard sci-fi, heightening the sense of realism to their stories. We're taking a closer look at this fan-favorite sub-genre and our personal favorite movies within it.

Diungkapkan bahwa while there are varying opinions about what qualifies as hard sci-fi, each of the movies we're including here certainly have a strong scientific grounding. Even some of the best sci-fi movies of 2026 are clear hard sci-fi projects, breathing new life into the sub-genre. With those qualities in mind, these are the best 15 hard sci-fi movies of all time ranked, each offering their own cinematic verisimilitude to the genre.

Berdasarkan laporan, after "2001: a space odyssey," there was "marooned," with gregory peck's space thriller based on the novel of the same name by martin caidin. As the incident becomes more public, Keith is forced to use an experimental spacecraft for the rescue, despite it being untested. Peck stars as NASA Director Charles Keith who finds himself working on a desperate rescue mission to save three astronauts stranded in orbit. Meanwhile, the stranded astronauts grow desperate as they begin to run out of oxygen before help arrives.

Diungkapkan bahwa "marooned" was released before the apollo 13 incident, which similarly saw american astronauts seemingly stranded in space. At the same time, the movie also keeps a tight focus on the human stakes, including the response back home and the families affected by the incident. While things like the movie's experimental spacecraft take it to sci-fi territory, the whole thing feels scientifically plausible. Overlooked by audiences today, nearly 60 years later, "Marooned" sets the template for so many subsequent space disaster movies on this list.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a big factor in a lot of hard sci-fi movies is its production budget, because it's far cheaper to make a grounded sci-fi movie than an outlandishly audacious one. Carruth plays Aaron, an engineer whose colleague Abe (David Sullivan) develops an amateur time machine in their garage. That certainly informs the 2004 indie movie "Primer," written, directed, produced, edited, and starring Shane Carruth, who also composed the score. As the duo explore the possibilities of their invention, they progressively experience the dire consequences of time travel.

Diungkapkan bahwa while "primer" may look and feel like a lofi time travel movie at first glance, it refreshingly explores its conflict from a well-thought approach. Things like the process' physical toll on the body from its wider ripple effects are smartly explored throughout the story. The production's DIY nature actually suits the narrative well, given the amateur nature of the movie's central plot device. If you haven't seen "Primer" before, the movie is a must-watch for sci-fi movie fans and a tightly constructed one at that.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 1997's "gattaca" is another sci-fi flick that feels eerily plausible for modern society to follow within the next several years. The story is set in a world where eugenics has become widespread to avoid the birth of babies with debilitating genetic conditions. This leads to society discriminating against those who carry genetic defects, including protagonist Vincent Freeman (Ethan Hawke). Posing as a genetically engineered individual, Vincent's ruse comes under scrutiny in the wake of a corporate executive's murder.

Sebagaimana diketahui, admittedly, "gattaca" is the most visually stylish movie on this list, but its concept and the level of technology depicted hold a real world weight to them. The movie goes into meticulous detail how Vincent is able to maintain his deception and how this genetic technology has impacted civilization. The science behind the story's genetic engineering and eugenics feels particularly well-developed as the cornerstone of this dystopian society. A dystopian noir look at the perils of artificial perfection, "Gattaca" is a moody flick that makes the most of its premise.

Diungkapkan bahwa filmmaker james cameron's most underrated movie is the 1989 underwater thriller "the abyss," with its core themes carried over into "avatar: the way of water. " The movie has American and Soviet teams racing to salvage a sunken American submarine from the bottom of the ocean. Leading the American expedition is an oil drilling crew headed by Bud Brigman (Ed Harris), only to find otherworldly entities are involved. As the full scope of this mission becomes apparent, Bud tries to stop hostilities from escalating between humanity and this underwater species.

Berdasarkan laporan, more than just standing as another cameron project that heavily involves the water, "the abyss" also showcases his sharp attention to detail. Cameron takes care to demonstrate the real-world dangers of deep-sea exploration, including the high pressure and chilling temperatures of the watery depths. These elements fuel the tension as much as the strange creatures that Bud encounters, along with Cameron's recurring message that unchecked human aggression is the true enemy. Claustrophobically staged and under-appreciated for years, "The Abyss" is Cameron's unsung classic and as grounded his sci-fi work gets.

Diungkapkan bahwa the first novel that author michael crichton published under his own name was 1969's "the andromeda strain," which was adapted for the silver screen in 1971. More intelligently assembled than the standard disaster movie fare of its time, the movie opens with a satellite crashing near a small town in New Mexico. After most of the community dies suddenly under mysterious causes, it's discovered that the satellite brought back a highly lethal extraterrestrial microorganism. The movie follows a team of scientists trying to contain the situation before it can wipe out all life on the planet.

Diungkapkan bahwa crichton's work tends to succeed the more firmly that they're rooted in reality before expanding into the fantastical. That strong scientific approach to the premise underscores the gravity that this threat is terrifyingly plausible. "The Andromeda Strain" is a prime example of this, still packing a punch over 50 years since its debut. Still one of the best Michael Crichton movie adaptations, "The Andromeda Strain" offers a grounded sci-fi approach to annihilation by contagion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while the 1972 adaptation of "solaris" by soviet filmmaker andrei tarkovsky is one of the best space horror movies ever made, it does veer tonally away from stanisław lem's novel. By contrast, Steven Soderbergh's 2002 adaptation is more of a drama and an isolated character study, though some existential thriller elements remain. The movie's protagonist is Chris Kelvin (George Clooney), a clinical psychologist who visits a remote space station only to find most of its crew is dead. As Kelvin investigates the situation, he is shocked to be reunited with his late wife Rheya (Natascha McElhone). who is seemingly alive and well.

Berdasarkan laporan, while it's a close call, soderbergh's "solaris" is a sci-fi remake that's better than the original, mostly because of change in tone and clooney's vulnerable performance. At its core, the story is a meditation on grief and guilt while Soderbergh builds his story in a relatively grounded outer space setting. This elevates the movie's ambiguous existential contemplation, while Soderbergh wisely keeps the sci-fi elements relatively stripped down. Soderbergh's "Solaris" is both his most understated and boldest project, using the mysteries of the cosmos to explore its emotional themes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the debut feature directorial project by british filmmaker duncan jones is the 2009 indie flick "moon. " The movie is largely a one-man show for Sam Rockwell, who plays Samuel Bell, a technician working alone in a lunar mining facility. As Bell nears the end of his three-year assignment, he begins to hallucinate, while his health steadily worsens. This culminates in Bell coming face-to-face with a doppelganger of himself, as he realizes the disturbing truth about his existence.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with its pragmatically minimalist art design and rockwell being the only actor on-screen for the majority of the movie, "moon" keeps its storytelling simple but effective. The idea that the Moon could be mined heavily for helium-3 is rooted in fact, while the technology is never particularly outlandish. Like Soderbergh's "Solaris," Jones keeps its narrative focus tightly on his protagonist which is where its real strength lies. An intimately scaled sci-fi thriller, "Moon" remains Duncan's best work to date, using its grounded backdrop to atmospheric effect.

Sebagaimana diketahui, among the sci-fi movies that nobody talks about anymore is "silent running," which was released in 1972. The story is set in a spaceship serving as a large biome for trees, tended to meticulously by botanist Freeman Lowell (Bruce Dern). The movie takes place in a future where Earth is no longer capable of supporting trees, forcing humanity to take its forestry off-world. When the crew is ordered to destroy the biomes by their corporate overseers, Lowell goes through murderous lengths to defend his carefully curated forests.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of all the movies on this list, "silent running" is the one with the most pointed sociopolitical commentary. Dern is rarely better than in his performance as Lowell, with his character standing as a portrait of single-minded obsession and carrying much of the movie. From its takedown of corporate greed to its eco-friendly themes, the movie feels like both a product of its time and as prescient as ever. Unabashedly direct in its messaging, "Silent Running" deserves wider recognition than it receives from the public these days.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, not every hard sci-fi movie needs to unfold in outer space or revolve around high concept narratives. Taking place in a near-future Los Angeles, loner Theodore Twombly (Joaquin Phoenix) struggles at forming a meaningful romantic connection with others. The 2013 romantic drama "Her" is perfectly set within a more intimate scope, given its premise. Instead, Theodore grows closer to his digital assistant Samantha (Scarlett Johansson) as she gains sentience, with a loving relationship growing between them.

Diungkapkan bahwa "her" is the perfect love story for the information age, underscoring that technological advances don't necessarily separate us from connecting with others. The tightened focus works well, with filmmaker Spike Jonze keeping the "Her" set intimate for Joaquin Phoenix, as he stays awkwardly vulnerable for much of the story. The movie's premise feels entirely plausible while also being prescient in the decade prior to the widespread proliferation of artificial intelligence. Understated in its tone and scope but still packing an emotional wallop, "Her" is Jonze's humanist masterpiece in an increasingly digital era.

Sebagaimana diketahui, among the most celebrated hard sci-fi authors of the 20th century was astronomer and science educator carl sagan. After astronomer Ellie Arroway (Jodie Foster) detects signs of intelligent otherworldly life, the world is galvanized by the discovery. The 1997 movie "Contact" adapted Sagan's 1985 novel of the same name, detailing humanity's first contact with extraterrestrial life. Though Arroway wants to make contact with these mysterious figures through an experimental device, complications quickly arise.

Diungkapkan bahwa while there is certainly extraterrestrial interaction to be had, "contact" is more about the reaction and fallout to confirmation of otherworldly life. Jodie Foster brings that thoroughly human response to the subject matter, while her character guides audiences through the story. "Contact" could've been a much stranger movie, treating Sagan and partner Ann Druyan's tale with tone-deaf disregard for scientific accuracy and characterization, but cooler heads won out. One of the best sci-fi movies of the '90s, hard with its science or not, "Contact" is an understated genre gem.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, upon its debut in 2026, "project hail mary" was quickly crowned as one of the best sci-fi movies ever and deservedly so. Molecular biologist Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) is forced to join an interstellar expedition searching for a way to restore the sun's output. Based on the best-selling novel by Andy Weir, the movie has our sun plagued by a strange substance threatening to dim it to catastrophic levels within decades. This leads Grace to team up with a rock-based extraterrestrial on his own mission to save his planet from the threat of the same substance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "project hail mary" improves upon andy weir's book in key ways, streamlining the story and quietly discarding its more superfluous sci-fi elements. But even with its interstellar partnership, the adaptation retains the source material's penchant for scientifically informed storytelling. That grounds the more cosmic elements as Grace finally enacts his last-ditch effort to save his world from chilly annihilation. Keeping hard sci-fi alive and well into the 2020s, "Project Hail Mary" is a bonafide crowd-pleaser.

Sebagaimana diketahui, still one of christopher nolan's most ambitious movies over a decade after its release, "interstellar" is the filmmaker's most high-flying tale to date. Like "Project Hail Mary" after it, the movie revolves around humanity at the brink of extinction, forced to undertake a desperate mission for its salvation. In the case of Nolan's story, Earth is rocked by severe dust storms affecting its agriculture, with astronaut Coop (Matthew McConaughey) leading an expedition for a habitable planet. This is juxtaposed by Coop's adult daughter Murph (Jessica Chastain) trying to find a way to create a spacecraft capable of launching into deep space through Earth's gravity.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while there are, of course, creative liberties taken through its premise, "interstellar" boasts a high level of scientific accuracy. Everything from planets undergoing significant time dilation to the gravity equation back on Earth all feel feasible, even with all the cinematic splendor. This includes the astrophysics propelling the story like the singularity that serves as the key to its spacefaring scope. Christopher Nolan always offers a well-thought approach to even the most fantastical subject matter, and "Interstellar" captures those qualities beautifully.

Sebagaimana diketahui, another british filmmaker who's excelled at smart sci-fi storytelling in the 21st century is alex garland. Arguably the hardest sci-fi story Garland has told thus far, and certainly one of the most effective, is the psychological thriller "Ex Machina. " The story follows programmer Caleb Smith (Domhnall Gleeson) who stays at the remote home of eccentric tech CEO Nathan Bateman (Oscar Isaac). Caleb is tasked with checking the sentience of Bateman's latest creation, a self-aware android known as Ava (Alicia Vikander) only for things to violently go off the rails.

Diungkapkan bahwa there is an underlying paranoia with existential overtones that permeate throughout "ex machina," carrying its narrative forward. This is underscored by its special effects, with the "Ex Machina" VFX avoiding green screen use, preferring practical effects and sets for its execution. Compared to more overtly cyberpunk stories like "Blade Runner," Garland's 2014 flick takes a much more grounded view on androids and the proliferation of artificial intelligence. A cautionary tale about billionaire vanity projects taking on a hostile life of their own, "Ex Machina" is Garland's most prescient work.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another adaptation of an andy weir novel to mention here is 2015's "the martian," directed and produced by ridley scott. The movie is set in a near-future where humanity has established a research station on Mars as part of an international coalition. After the station's team evacuates from the planet during a severe dust storm, astronaut Mark Watney (Matt Damon) is accidentally left behind. Until a rescue mission can be carried out, Watney has to rely on the tools that he has available and his own wits to survive alone on Mars.

Sebagaimana diketahui, andy weir gave the 2015 adaptation of "the martian" his seal of approval, and we do too. Matt Damon has to perform much the movie alone, expertly conveying his character's intellectual reasoning without coming off as overly dry or talking down to the audience. The movie is Scott's most buoyantly light, yet it doesn't compromise the scientific know-how behind Watney's prolonged ordeal. One of the smartest sci-fi blockbusters of the 2010s, "The Martian" treats its premise well while celebrating intelligence to save the day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the most prolific hard sci-fi authors was arthur c. Clarke, who teamed up with filmmaker Stanley Kubrick for "2001: A Space Odyssey. " The 1968 movie traces humanity's evolution through a strange extraterrestrial monolith that first appeared on Earth during prehistoric times. When a monolith found on the Moon transits a signal to Jupiter, an expedition is mounted to investigate further. This voyage is nearly derailed by the malevolent artificial intelligence HAL 9000 (Douglas Rain) running the team's spaceship.

#732. Mads Mikkelsen Delivered His Best Performance In This Unforgettable 2012 Movie

Mads Mikkelsen Delivered His Best Performance In This Unforgettable 2012 Movie

Sebagaimana diketahui, few european actors have found the blend of native and international success that mads mikkelsen has. " He's since become a favorite of Hollywood productions, too, starting with his role as the Bond villain Le Chiffre in "Casino Royale. Born in Denmark, he became a star in his home country during the 1990s and 2000s, his career kicking off with Nicolas Winding Refn's 1996 crime thriller "Pusher. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, since then, mikkelsen has remained a go-to hollywood bad guy, appearing in blockbusters like marvel studios' "doctor strange. More than a few would argue Mikkelsen's Lecter in the 2013 TV series "Hannibal" is even better than Anthony Hopkins in "The Silence of the Lambs. " He's also one of the privileged few to have played arguably the most famous screen villain ever, Hannibal Lecter. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa mikkelsen's razor-sharp cheekbones, intense stare, and european accent instantly code him as "villain" in hollywood language. When "Rogue One: A Star Wars Story" cast him as Galen Erso, a sympathetic scientist conscripted into building the Death Star, it read as casting against type to American audiences. But look at Mikkelsen's Danish resume and you'll find he's a much more diverse actor than the box that Hollywood has stuck him inside. Amusingly, one of those movies — Thomas Vinterberg's "The Hunt" — stars Mikkelsen as a good man mistakenly persecuted as a villain.

Diungkapkan bahwa lucas (mikkelsen) is a danish kindergarten teacher. Klara then vengefully suggests to the school principal that Lucas exposed himself to or molested her. One of his students, his best friend Theo's (Thomas Bo Larsen) daughter Klara (Annika Wedderkopp), has a puppy love crush on him. (In reality, as the movie shows, her crude older brother shoved an iPad displaying porn in her face. Obviously, he gently turns her down. ) The ugly rumor grows out of control, and Lucas' reputation pays the price.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in "the hunt," the town rushes to the worst possible conclusion about lucas. All but a few loved ones like his son, Marcus (Lasse Fogelstrøm), believe the worst from hearsay. But they don't actually know it for a fact (indeed, what ultimately helps clear Lucas is the facts pointing in his favor). "The Hunt" also avoids reactionary narratives about scorned women peddling false rape allegations because Klara is a young child. The movie is never ambiguous, though; we know from the very beginning that Lucas is innocent and this is all just a terrible tragedy of miscommunication. She simply doesn't grasp the consequences of what she did, as is the case with the other preschoolers who echo her claims.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, compare a similar recent film, "fjord," inspired by a real-life story about a norwegian evangelical couple whose children were taken from them after suspicions of abuse. Like in "The Hunt," the allegations are implied to stem from leading questions and miscommunication from the kids. But "Fjord" counterintuitively stacks the deck in the parents' favor while trying to present objectivity, perhaps because it knows many left-leaning audiences are inclined to side against the conservative couple and takes perverse enjoyment in testing those sympathies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a film like "the hunt" could choose not to reveal lucas' innocence either way or cast doubt, inviting you to sympathize with a possible monster as an endurance test. But the reality of "The Hunt," seeing an innocent man be branded with a scarlet letter, is also agonizing to watch in its own way. It's a modern iteration on the parable of the feathers in the wind, and how once spoken, even untruthful gossip can't be erased.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as lucas, mikkelsen sheds any of the power or menace he projects as a villain in those aforementioned hollywood movies. "The Hunt" is also a Danish-language film, and Mikkelsen's comfort with his native tongue also makes for an even more seamless performance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to this day, i've never forgotten the catharsis of a scene where lucas stands up for himself. After being assaulted in a grocery store, he walks in again, headbutts the hostile clerk, and demands his groceries back. The first time I watched "The Hunt," I rewound the movie to see the scene a second time.

Berdasarkan laporan, that relatively late-in-the-movie scene is a well-earned respite from lucas' victimhood. Even in a story like this, too much passivity from a protagonist turns into a chore. Again, Klara's father Theo is Lucas' best friend; while Theo takes Klara's side, he claims to know Lucas so well he can tell when he's lying or truthful by just looking into his eyes. Lucas similarly takes matters into his own hands at the movie's emotional climax. Lucas goes to Christmas Mass, putting himself dead center in the community that has exiled him, and looks at Theo across the pews.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the power of this lynchpin scene is in mikkelsen's silent, icy stare (lucas pointedly ditches his glasses during this scene). But it's not the aloof stare of Le Chiffre or the predatory one of Hannibal Lecter. In his sad eyes and slight frown, Lucas is begging Theo to read the truth on his face. When that's not enough, he storms over to Theo, sobbing, and refuses to let him look away from his eyes.

Berdasarkan laporan, mads mikkelsen is an extraordinary actor, and yet the greatest proof of that is him playing a normal man in "the hunt. ".

Also, how White Chicks influenced a key scene.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the body, netflix’s new campy-horror tv series, came out this week. But based on a quick social media browse, it might as well have come out months ago. The high school thriller inspired passionate fan debates among viewers and dozens of fan cams dedicated to favorite characters long before a single episode aired. Now that The Body has finally arrived, however, fans are having an entirely different debate that hinges on its wild cliffhanger ending.

In search of answers, we turned to co-showrunners Quinn Shephard and Gina Gammell, who admit they don't even know where the series is headed next and that they enjoy the conversation the finale has inspired.

"We are amiable and gullible and don't have an answer either," Gammell tells Polygon.

Below, we break down some of The Body's biggest season 1 mysteries with Shephard and Gammell, and discuss where the story might be headed next.

The following contains spoilers for The Body season 1 ending.

Diungkapkan bahwa broadly, the body follows a high school dance team who may or may not have sacrificed a girl’s soul to qualify for their regionals competition. Through its eight episodes, the show explores the shifting dynamics and allegiances between its three main characters: Anya (Kristina Bogic), Lisbeth (Geena Meszaros), and Elise (Sara Boustany).

Berdasarkan laporan, season 1 ends with anya confessing the sins that had been eating at her all through the season, including both her sexuality and the fact that she feels responsible for the series’ inciting incident, where grace (sofia wylie) fell into a coma after taking some ecstasy at a halloween party. Anya reveals that, when Grace started feeling sick, she decided to drive her to the hospital, only for Grace to seemingly die in the back seat. In a spur-of-the-moment decision, Anya returns Grace’s body to her bedroom and tucks her in, hoping to cover it all up without having to deal with the consequences.

Berdasarkan laporan, following anya’s confession, grace wakes up, stunning everyone, and says, “i’m god. ” It’s the season’s final line of dialogue and one heck of a cliffhanger.

“It was the place we were always aiming towards,” Shephard says.

Shephard and Gammell agree that what they enjoy the most about the season finale is the fact that it can inspire passionate debates.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we want people to feel similarly at the end to the way you feel at all of the biggest turns of the show, which is a continued curiosity about what is really going on, and a certain autonomy to influence that in your own watching," shephard says. ' I think those are our favorite conversations to witness. ' And then someone else is like, 'No, in the last episode, they said that she could hear stuff in the coma. "A certain ability to be like, 'No, I know for sure that she's possessed. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the question of what’s real and what’s imagined lies at the core of the series, which is constantly pitting religion against reality. The many supernatural appearances and occurrences that take place could be part of a mass delusion, or they could be a miracle.

Berdasarkan laporan, gammell says that the theories that people share with them “entirely convince us each time. ' We're like, 'You're right. It is the devil. That is correct too. It doesn't matter. ' And someone else is like, 'No, no, she has a drug interaction. Depending on who we're speaking to, we're like, 'You're right. '".

If the show gets renewed for season 2, one thing is clear:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "grace will be awake," gammell says. She and Shephard are excited to write new dialogue for Wylie beyond "I'm God. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa whatever comes next, shephard and gammell seem to want their show to continue to straddle the line between science and religion. At least for now, they want no clear-cut answers.

Berdasarkan laporan, “we’re both people who believe in science and ghosts,” shephard says. “So I think that we fall in the middle. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, much of the body works because it’s at its best when navigating tones that seem opposite, at least on paper. Shephard began writing the show’s pilot as a drama; it was only after some time had passed and she and Gammell began working together that they landed on the campy tone that makes the series so memorable.

“I think the satire and the comedy of the show was very much born from our working collaboration on it, and Gina finding the stories of things that upset me as a teenager quite funny,” Shephard says.

Berdasarkan laporan, an example of this is a scene that depicts our three lead characters in the car together, with tensions at an all-time high. Shephard reveals that after she had written it and finalized it, she got an idea for the scene’s tone from watching White Chicks.

“I sent a still to my DP and said, ‘I think this is how the scene should look: them in the convertible: White Chicks,’” Shephard recalls.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you’ve seen the body, you know exactly what scene shephard is talking about. While the actors play it like a serious drama, the tone makes it one of the show’s funniest moments. The result is a marriage of two seemingly opposing sensibilities.

#737. Why Batman: The Animated Series Chose Man-Bat As Its First Villain

Why Batman: The Animated Series Chose Man-Bat As Its First Villain

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2310295/why-man-bat-first-batman-the-animated-series-villain/

We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "batman: the animated series" is darker than most superhero cartoons before and since — literally darker. But it wasn't only gangsters that went bump in the night. Drawn on black paper, "Batman: The Animated Series" presents Gotham City like an art deco painting mixed with an old Hollywood crime movie. The very first episode, "On Leather Wings," uses one of the most out-there Batman villains: Man-Bat, aka zoologist Kirk Langstrom (Marc Singer), transformed by a potion into a half-man/half-bat creature like a winged werewolf.

Berdasarkan laporan, debuting in 1970's "detective comics" #400 by frank robbins and neal adams, man-bat had 20+ years of comics history behind him when "on leather wings" was made. But for non-comic fans, that episode would be the first time they'd seen him. According to "Batman: The Animated Series" co-creator Bruce Timm, that's exactly why he was the pilot's villain. In "Modern Masters Volume 3: Bruce Timm," he recounted:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "man-bat was chosen specifically [for the first episode] because he wasn't familiar to very many people outside of comic book fans. It wasn't like the Joker, where you had to deal with people expecting him to be Jack Nicholson or Cesar Romero. Nobody had any preconceived notions about him. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "on leather wings" was written by mitch brian, who had also developed the "batman" series bible. What became "On Leather Wings" originated as an episode premise in that bible, though with the gruesome detail that Man-Bat was killing tourists, which isn't in the episode as made. Brian has said he pushed for Man-Bat to give the series a dash of the fantastical right off the bat (no pun intended) — "Batman: The Animated Series" could do not just film noir, but also Universal Horror-esque mad science and monsters.

Sebagaimana diketahui, man-bat as batman's first villain also carries narrative symmetry. His moniker is a twist on Batman's own and he takes Batman's mission to "become a bat" one step further. "Man-Bat kind of works because he's literally the reverse of Batman and he's also got the obsessive interest in bats," said Bruce Timm in "Modern Masters. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, technically, catwoman's debut episode "the cat and the claw" premiered first on september 5, 1992, one day earlier than "on leather wings" did. (Currently, "The Cat and the Claw" is also listed as the first episode of "Batman: The Animated Series" on HBO Max. "Batman Returns," starring Michelle Pfeiffer as Catwoman, had hit theaters that past summer. ) But, functionally, "On Leather Wings" is a much better pilot episode — because that's what it was made to be.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it also demonstrated that "batman: the animated series" was more than just a movie tie-in, down to the choice of villain. " Remember, this was 1992, a year before "Jurassic Park" unlocked the potential of CGI. In "I Am The Night: The Ultimate Unauthorized History of Batman Series," author Daniel Dockery notes a villain like Man-Bat would've been "nigh impossible to pull off in live-action. A human-sized bat monster? And an action scene where it flies through Gotham with Batman towed behind it on a rope? Yeah, in the 1990s, a live-action "Batman" movie that even attempted any of that would look ridiculous. But in a cartoon, it was thrilling, and proved "Batman: The Animated Series" was a canvas for unique Batman stories.

Starting with "On Leather Wings" also highlights another tenet from the aforementioned "Batman" series bible: no origin story episodes, because the audience already knew Batman's origin from decades of prior "Batman" comics, movies, and cartoons.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during "on leather wings," the police mistake man-bat for batman (kevin conroy) and hunt the dark knight instead. This premise rests on Gotham City already knowing Batman, which is only possible because the series starts in media res with Batman as an experienced crimefighter. The first time we see Batman is deliberately unspectacular; he's sitting in the Batcave, in costume, reading a newspaper article about the Man-Bat attacks.

Diungkapkan bahwa the "batman is framed" subplot also demonstrates that this isn't the adam west show where batman is literally deputized by the police and trusted by all of gotham as a paragon of justice. Many people are already scared of Batman, so it's not a huge leap to blame him for Man-Bat's attacks. (The series' movie spin-off, "Batman: Mask of the Phantasm," even used a nigh-identical story, with Batman being mistaken for the film's eponymous villain. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, turning man-bat's identity into a mystery differs from his first appearance in the comics. There, we meet Man-Bat as Langstrom first and see his gradual and tragic transformation. Mitch Brian compared Man-Bat to "The Strange Case of Dr. It also, crucially, allows Batman to act as a detective. Hyde," and by making "On Leather Wings" a mystery, it brings Man-Bat closer to that book. Jekyll and Mr. The twist of Man-Bat being Langstrom works because, again, he's not a villain most of the audience already knew inside-and-out.

Sebagaimana diketahui, artist kevin nowlan, who had drawn a man-bat story in dc's "secret origins" #39, was initially recruited to design the villain. (See his concept art above. In form and function, Man-Bat was the perfect pilot villain for "Batman: The Animated Series. ) Bruce Timm's finalized design includes his characters' standard broad upper chest, which fits well with Man-Bat's arms growing out into wings. ".
