Sebagaimana diketahui, fanfiction is one of the oldest genres out there. For fans, it's a fun exercise that keeps them connected to a world they love. Classic authors like Ovid and William Shakespeare often took existing characters or rewrote existing stories and myths. net, Wattpad, and Archive of Our Own (AO3) allow users to write amateur, unauthorized fiction based on existing copyrighted works. The same is true today, to a certain extent. Websites like FanFiction. Sagas like Harry Potter, Twilight, and Star Wars have inspired many popular fan stories. It was a clever move, since audiences would already be familiar with the characters and the story. For a few writers, it can become a new and highly successful path to publication.

Diungkapkan bahwa retellings, reboots and yes, fanfictions, are so successful because they come with a built-in audience. The same is true for fanfiction. With some smart editing and tweaking, these works can stand as their own books and stories. Although fans might have first started reading a fanfiction because of their love for the original characters, they stayed because of the new story. Here are the most popular ones.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, famously inspired by twilight, the book series written by e. L. James might not have been the first fanfiction to be professionally published, but it did make the most noise. While the original Twilight is a YA series written by a Mormon author, Fifty Shades of Grey is an erotic romance that delves into the world of BDSM. This is probably due to the contrast between the genres and themes of the original story and its retelling. Yes, naive Anastasia Steele is clearly inspired by Bella Swan and controlling billionaire Christian Grey takes its personality from that of Edward Cullen, but their lives are very different.

Sebagaimana diketahui, e. James originally posted what would become Fifty Shades of Grey with the title of "Master of the Universe" on FanFiction. Once it hit bookstores, it became an instant success, selling over 150 million copies across the trilogy and being adapted into a movie franchise starring Dakota Johnson and Jamie Dornan. The prose and the portrayal of BDSM and consent has been widely criticized. Looking back at the story, it has not stood the test of time well. L. Following complaints about the story's explicit content, she then took it down and rewrote it as original fiction. net. However, its role as the fanfiction trailblazer is impossible to deny.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the more controversial forms of fanfiction is that based on real people. The book The Idea of You, which became a popular Prime Video movie, is another example, although it was never published on a fanfiction website. The boy band One Direction was one of the most popular inspirations for these types of stories and, specifically, Harry Styles. The book After by Anna Todd is the most famous of all.

Diungkapkan bahwa anna todd wrote after under the name of imaginator1d, updating the story almost daily. Hardin's friends, inspired by other One Direction members, also make appearances, although the plot is entirely original. Marketed as a "Wattpad sensation," the story is set on a fictional American college campus, where sheltered freshman Tessa Young, played by Josephine Langford in the movie, meets Hardin Scott, inspired by Harry Styles and portrayed by Hero Fiennes Tiffin. Nonetheless, many readers have criticized the toxicity of Tessa and Hardin’s relationship, both on the page and in its movie adaptations.

Diungkapkan bahwa here comes an original story that became fanfiction before it was published as first intended. Rachel Reid, angry at the homophobia in the hockey world, wrote the first Game Changers novel as an original gay romance. The story follows Scott Hunter, a New York hockey team captain, and Kip Grady, a smoothie-shop employee. Diungkapkan bahwa the story was never intended as fanfiction, but it has deep connections to the genre. The published version is what she always intended. The author has since said she regrets it and that her characters were never really Steve and Bucky. In 2016, looking for an audience for her story, Rachel Reid published the first book in the series on the website Archive of Our Own. Without it, readers would have never met Shane and Ilya, and the romance that is now a cultural phenomenon.

Berdasarkan laporan, you, again is the only book on this list inspired by two different fandoms. Goldbeck eventually rewrote the story and turned it into a gender-swapped retelling of the movie When Harry Met Sally. The first origins of the story were as fanfiction inspired by the romance between Rey (Daisy Ridley) and Kylo Ren (Adam Driver) from the Star Wars sequel trilogy. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in this version of the story, ari, inspired by harry (billy crystal), is a stand-up comic living in new york. She first meets the earnest and ambitious Josh, inspired by Sally (Meg Ryan), in an unconventional way: they both happen to be sleeping with the same woman. The two hate each other instantly.
